logline: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 18's devastating fire; Juliana and Alexander stand amidst the morning ruins of Blackwood cottage with her mother's surviving herbal book before retreating to an abandoned barn.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: EXT. BLACKWOOD COTTAGE RUINS – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: EXT. BLACKWOOD COTTAGE RUINS – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:41.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.50)
Full shot of Juliana and Alexander standing side by side amidst the charred, smoldering wreckage of their destroyed cottage, thick smoke rising behind them into the overcast sky.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.50)
Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.

**JULIANA (Sorrowful, Hollow):**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:03.50)
"This was our home."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:09.50)
Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.

**JULIANA (Emotional, Fragile):**
Start: (00:05.10) | End: (00:08.20)
"My mother's book almost burned with it."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:06.50) | End: (00:09.20)
Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.50) | End: (00:11.80)
Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.80) | End: (00:15.50)
Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.

**ELDER VILLAGER (Respectful, Sincere):**
Start: (00:12.10) | End: (00:15.20)
"My lady. You cannot stay here."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:18.50)
Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.

**ELDER VILLAGER (O.S.):**
Start: (00:16.10) | End: (00:19.00)
"There is an old barn near the village. It is empty."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:18.50) | End: (00:20.50)
The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.

**ELDER VILLAGER (Gentle, Earnest):**
Start: (00:19.40) | End: (00:20.40)
"Take it."

**JULIANA (Hesitant, Humble):**
Start: (00:20.60) | End: (00:22.60)
"We cannot ask the village to feed us."

**ELDER VILLAGER (Warm, Grateful):**
Start: (00:23.20) | End: (00:25.20)
"You saved my son's life."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:25.80) | End: (00:28.20)
Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.

**ELDER VILLAGER (O.S.):**
Start: (00:26.40) | End: (00:27.80)
"You saved mine, too."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.20) | End: (00:30.80)
Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.

**JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful):**
Start: (00:28.50) | End: (00:29.80)
"Thank you."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:34.50)
Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.

**ALEXANDER (Deep, Solemn):**
Start: (00:31.20) | End: (00:33.20)
"We will not forget this kindness."

**ELDER VILLAGER (Nodding, Earnest):**
Start: (00:33.30) | End: (00:34.80)
"Neither will the village."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.80) | End: (00:38.20)
Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.

**JULIANA (Choked Up, Mournful):**
Start: (00:35.50) | End: (00:37.40)
"Goodbye, Blackwood."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:38.00) | End: (00:41.50)
Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: EXT. MISTY DEEP WOODS – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: EXT. MISTY DEEP WOODS – DAY
Scene start: 00:41.50
Scene end: 01:29.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:41.50) | End: (00:44.20)
Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:46.00)
A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.

**INFORMANT (Subservient, Urgent):**
Start: (00:44.30) | End: (00:45.80)
"Your Grace."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.00) | End: (00:49.20)
Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.

**ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Direct):**
Start: (00:47.10) | End: (00:49.20)
"Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."

**INFORMANT (Grave, Cautious):**
Start: (00:49.50) | End: (00:54.80)
"Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.30) | End: (01:01.40)
Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.

**INFORMANT (O.S.):**
Start: (00:55.30) | End: (01:01.30)
"Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:01.40) | End: (01:04.80)
Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.

**INFORMANT (Earnest):**
Start: (01:01.60) | End: (01:04.80)
"And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.80) | End: (01:10.60)
Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.

**INFORMANT (Whispering, Alarmed):**
Start: (01:05.10) | End: (01:10.50)
"But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.60) | End: (01:13.30)
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.

**INFORMANT (O.S.):**
Start: (01:10.90) | End: (01:13.20)
"There are almost no loyal servants left around her."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.30) | End: (01:16.20)
Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.

**INFORMANT (Grave):**
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:16.40)
"The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:16.20) | End: (01:18.80)
Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Pained Fury):**
Start: (01:16.50) | End: (01:18.80)
"My mother is a prisoner in her own house."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.80) | End: (01:21.20)
Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.

**INFORMANT (Quiet, Solemn):**
Start: (01:19.00) | End: (01:21.00)
"And everyone believes you are dead."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.20) | End: (01:23.80)
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.

**ALEXANDER (Lethal, Calculating):**
Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:23.70)
"Then let them believe it a little longer."

**INFORMANT (Inquiring, Tense):**
Start: (01:24.00) | End: (01:25.50)
"And when we have the proof?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:25.50) | End: (01:29.50)
Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.

**ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance, Resolute):**
Start: (01:25.90) | End: (01:28.90)
"Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – NIGHT
Scene start: 01:29.50
Scene end: 01:59.63

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:29.50) | End: (01:34.00)
Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:34.00) | End: (01:36.80)
Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:37.80)
Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:37.20) | End: (01:40.00)
The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.

**JULIANA (O.S.):**
Start: (01:37.40) | End: (01:39.40)
"We have lost everything."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.90) | End: (01:43.00)
Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.

**JULIANA (Despairing, Broken):**
Start: (01:40.40) | End: (01:42.60)
"I don't know what we will do tomorrow."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:43.00) | End: (01:46.00)
Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.

**ALEXANDER (Soft, Steadfast):**
Start: (01:44.20) | End: (01:46.20)
"Tomorrow, we begin again."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:46.00) | End: (01:49.80)
Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.

**JULIANA (Faint Smile, Emotional):**
Start: (01:47.30) | End: (01:49.20)
"You make it sound so simple."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:49.80) | End: (01:52.50)
Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:52.50) | End: (01:59.63)
Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen.

--- SCRIPT END ---

timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Hesitant, Humble)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "We cannot ask the village to feed us."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ELDER VILLAGER (Warm, Grateful)
timeline_events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
timeline_events.text: "You saved my son's life."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ELDER VILLAGER (O.S.)
timeline_events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
timeline_events.text: "You saved mine, too."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "Thank you."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Solemn)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "We will not forget this kindness."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ELDER VILLAGER (Nodding, Earnest)
timeline_events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
timeline_events.text: "Neither will the village."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Choked Up, Mournful)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "Goodbye, Blackwood."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (Subservient, Urgent)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "Your Grace."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Direct)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (Grave, Cautious)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (Earnest)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (Whispering, Alarmed)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (Grave)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Pained Fury)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "My mother is a prisoner in her own house."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (Quiet, Solemn)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "And everyone believes you are dead."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Lethal, Calculating)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Then let them believe it a little longer."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: INFORMANT (Inquiring, Tense)
timeline_events.speaker: INFORMANT
timeline_events.text: "And when we have the proof?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance, Resolute)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (O.S.)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "We have lost everything."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Despairing, Broken)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "I don't know what we will do tomorrow."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Steadfast)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Tomorrow, we begin again."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Faint Smile, Emotional)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "You make it sound so simple."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-019-Episode 1671721.txt

logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 19's night in the barn; as Alexander begins his clandestine fight to reclaim his birthright, Juliana tends to the suffering village while Rupert and Catherine celebrate their anticipated ascension to the ducal throne.

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:02.80
Scene end: 00:56.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:02.80) | End: (00:06.80)
Medium wide shot of the lavish drawing room. CATHERINE, dressed in an ornate lilac regency gown and white satin gloves, gracefully pours hot tea from an ornate silver teapot, while RUPERT stands elegantly by the tall window.

**CATHERINE (Smug, Prim):**
Start: (00:02.90) | End: (00:04.40)
"Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?"

**CATHERINE (Taunting, Silkily):**
Start: (00:04.60) | End: (00:07.80)
"Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:06.90) | End: (00:09.50)
Close-up of Catherine stirring her tea with a silver spoon, lifting her gaze with a haughty smirk.

**RUPERT (Flirtatious, Sly):**
Start: (00:08.20) | End: (00:10.80)
"Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.60) | End: (00:15.20)
Medium shot tracking Rupert as he steps forward from the hearth, adjusting his dark leather gloves with an air of absolute triumph.

**RUPERT (Boastful, Confident):**
Start: (00:10.90) | End: (00:12.70)
"The estate is practically ours."

**RUPERT (Smug):**
Start: (00:12.80) | End: (00:15.10)
"The succession papers are being finalized as we speak."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.20) | End: (00:20.00)
Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.

**CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty):**
Start: (00:15.40) | End: (00:18.70)
"'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."

**CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious):**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:20.10)
"I marry the Lord of Ashbury."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.00) | End: (00:25.50)
Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

**RUPERT (Reassuring, Firm):**
Start: (00:20.10) | End: (00:21.20)
"And so you shall."

**RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial):**
Start: (00:21.30) | End: (00:24.20)
"Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."

**RUPERT (Decisive):**
Start: (00:24.30) | End: (00:25.40)
"...the title is mine."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:25.50) | End: (00:30.20)
Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

**CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring):**
Start: (00:25.50) | End: (00:28.20)
"And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."

**CATHERINE (Disdainful):**
Start: (00:28.30) | End: (00:30.20)
"Her shadow still hangs over this house."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.20) | End: (00:34.00)
Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

**RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister):**
Start: (00:30.20) | End: (00:32.80)
"Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."

**RUPERT (Gloating):**
Start: (00:32.90) | End: (00:34.40)
"They call it a wasting of the lungs."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.10) | End: (00:39.20)
Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

**CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel):**
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:36.80)
"How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."

**CATHERINE (Scheming):**
Start: (00:36.90) | End: (00:39.10)
"How much longer can the frail thing survive?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:39.30) | End: (00:42.50)
Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.

**RUPERT (Cold, Callous):**
Start: (00:39.40) | End: (00:42.40)
"Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.50) | End: (00:50.00)
Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.

**CATHERINE (Vindictive):**
Start: (00:42.60) | End: (00:44.90)
"Good. The village is already whispering about her."

**CATHERINE (Contemptuous):**
Start: (00:45.00) | End: (00:48.40)
"The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes."

**CATHERINE (Disgusted):**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:49.80)
"They disgust me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:50.00) | End: (00:56.50)
Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.

**RUPERT (Dismissive, Arrogant):**
Start: (00:50.20) | End: (00:52.50)
"They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots."

**RUPERT (Authoritative, Promising):**
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:56.00)
"They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown."

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY
Scene start: 00:56.50
Scene end: 01:28.20

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:56.50) | End: (01:00.30)
Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:00.00) | End: (01:04.50)
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

**SEAMUS (Gentle, Concerned):**
Start: (01:00.50) | End: (01:02.50)
"Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana."

**SEAMUS (Empathetic):**
Start: (01:02.60) | End: (01:06.60)
"Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:04.80) | End: (01:06.80)
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

**JULIANA (Fierce, Resolute):**
Start: (01:06.70) | End: (01:09.10)
"If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins."

**JULIANA (Defiant):**
Start: (01:09.20) | End: (01:10.50)
"I do not yield to a cold draft."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:16.20)

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. BARN – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. BARN – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:40.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.50)
Medium shot of Lady Juliana in a rustic grey gown, her wrists wrapped in white bandages, smoothing a blanket over a straw pallet in the dimly lit barn.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.50)
Lady Juliana gently straightens the grey wool blanket over the hay bed, exhaling a soft, exhausted sigh.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:03.50) | End: (00:04.80)
A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:03.60) | End: (00:08.50)
Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.

**PRUDENCE (Desperate, Panicked):**
Start: (00:04.20) | End: (00:08.00)
"Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:08.20) | End: (00:10.50)
Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:11.20)
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

**LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Urgent):**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:11.00)
"Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.20) | End: (00:15.10)
Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

**PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Breathless):**
Start: (00:11.20) | End: (00:15.00)
"My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.10) | End: (00:18.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

**LADY JULIANA (Inquiring, Strained):**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:18.20)
"Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.20) | End: (00:21.80)
Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

**PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful):**
Start: (00:18.20) | End: (00:21.70)
"He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:25.00)
Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

**PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful):**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:25.30)
"The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:25.00) | End: (00:30.90)
Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

**LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected):**
Start: (00:25.10) | End: (00:27.40)
"We have no clinic now."

**LADY JULIANA (Despondent):**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:30.80)
"Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:33.00)
Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.10) | End: (00:35.80)
High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

**PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate):**
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:35.80)
"He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:39.50)
Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.90) | End: (00:40.50)
Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.

**LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative):**
Start: (00:35.90) | End: (00:40.40)
"Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: EXT. VILLAGE LANE – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: EXT. VILLAGE LANE – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:40.50
Scene end: 00:42.80

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:40.50) | End: (00:42.80)
Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:40.50) | End: (00:42.80)
Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: INT. PRUDENCE'S COTTAGE – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: INT. PRUDENCE'S COTTAGE – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:42.80
Scene end: 01:54.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:45.50)
Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:45.50)
Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:48.00)
Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:48.50)
Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.

**LADY JULIANA (Alarmed, Focused):**
Start: (00:47.30) | End: (00:48.80)
"His skin is burning hot."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:48.80) | End: (00:50.50)
Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.80) | End: (00:51.20)
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.

**LADY JULIANA (Commanding):**
Start: (00:48.90) | End: (00:50.80)
"Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.20) | End: (00:54.00)
Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.

**PRUDENCE (Hurried, Obedient):**
Start: (00:51.20) | End: (00:53.00)
"Yes! Right away, I will get it!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:55.00)
Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (00:56.20)
Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.

**LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Introspective, Determined):**
Start: (00:54.10) | End: (00:58.20)
"I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:00.50)
Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:00.80)
Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.00)
Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.50)
Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.

**LADY JULIANA (Instructive, Calm):**
Start: (01:01.00) | End: (01:04.00)
"Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.80)
Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.

**PRUDENCE (Tearful, Coaxing):**
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.60)
"Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.50)
Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.

**LADY JULIANA (Encouraging, Reassuring):**
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.40)
"Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.50)
Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:12.00)
Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:12.00) | End: (01:16.00)
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

**PRUDENCE (Overwhelmed, Relieved):**
Start: (01:12.00) | End: (01:15.50)
"Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:15.50) | End: (01:19.50)
Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.00) | End: (01:19.80)
Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

**LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Caring):**
Start: (01:16.00) | End: (01:19.60)
"Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:19.80) | End: (01:27.50)
Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

**PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion):**
Start: (01:19.80) | End: (01:23.00)
"You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you..."

**PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted):**
Start: (01:23.00) | End: (01:27.50)
"I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:30.80)
Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:31.00)
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

**LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere):**
Start: (01:27.70) | End: (01:30.50)
"Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:36.50)
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

**PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful):**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:34.50)
"At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury."

**PRUDENCE (Ominous):**
Start: (01:34.60) | End: (01:36.40)
"But their gold cannot buy them health."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:38.20)
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:39.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

**LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious):**
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:39.20)
"What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.20) | End: (01:41.20)
Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

**PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.):**
Start: (01:39.20) | End: (01:41.20)
"She is dying, Lady Juliana."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:46.80)
Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.

**PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim):**
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:43.40)
"A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away."

**PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling):**
Start: (01:43.50) | End: (01:48.40)
"Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:46.80) | End: (01:48.50)
Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:48.50) | End: (01:54.00)
Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:48.50) | End: (01:54.00)
Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.

scenes.heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:42.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.00)
Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.00)
Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.00) | End: (00:07.00)
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:06.50) | End: (00:08.50)
Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.

**PRUDENCE (Urgent, Whispering):**
Start: (00:07.00) | End: (00:11.10)
"Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.10) | End: (00:14.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.

**LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Quiet):**
Start: (00:11.20) | End: (00:14.20)
"No one will recognize me dressed like this."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:14.20) | End: (00:19.00)
Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.

**PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning):**
Start: (00:14.20) | End: (00:19.00)
"This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.00) | End: (00:21.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.

**LADY JULIANA (Determined):**
Start: (00:19.10) | End: (00:21.00)
"The Duchess is dying."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.20) | End: (00:25.80)
Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.

**LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm):**
Start: (00:22.00) | End: (00:25.50)
"I saved Toby. I can save her."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:25.80) | End: (00:28.10)
Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

**PRUDENCE (Fretful):**
Start: (00:26.00) | End: (00:28.10)
"And if they discover who you are?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.10) | End: (00:31.50)
Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

**LADY JULIANA (Steely, Selfless):**
Start: (00:28.20) | End: (00:31.00)
"Then I will face that when she is breathing again."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.50) | End: (00:36.20)
Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.

**PRUDENCE (Solemn):**
Start: (00:33.80) | End: (00:36.00)
"Then forget you were ever a lady."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.20) | End: (00:39.80)
Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.

**LADY JULIANA (Quietly Resolute):**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:39.50)
"Today, I am only a maid."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:42.50)
Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:41.50) | End: (00:42.80)
Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.

SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:42.50
Scene end: 01:28.50

Actions and dialogue:

**HOUSEKEEPER (Sharp, Stern, O.S.):**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:44.20)
"Prudence."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:46.00)
Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.

**HOUSEKEEPER (Suspicious):**
Start: (00:44.30) | End: (00:45.60)
"Who is this?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.00) | End: (00:49.20)
Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.

**PRUDENCE (Submissive):**
Start: (00:46.00) | End: (00:49.00)
"Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.20) | End: (00:52.20)
Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.

**HOUSEKEEPER (Cold, Skeptical):**
Start: (00:49.50) | End: (00:51.80)
"She looks soft."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:51.80) | End: (00:53.00)
Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:55.20)
Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.

**LADY JULIANA (Humble, Steady):**
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:54.80)
"I can work, ma'am."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.20) | End: (00:58.50)
Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.

**HOUSEKEEPER (Demanding):**
Start: (00:56.00) | End: (00:58.00)
"Can you scrub stone?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:00.00)
Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.

**LADY JULIANA (Subdued):**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (00:59.80)
"Yes, ma'am."

**HOUSEKEEPER (Harsh, O.S.):**
Start: (01:00.20) | End: (01:01.80)
"Carry coal?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.20) | End: (01:02.30)
Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.30) | End: (01:04.20)
Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.

**LADY JULIANA (Polite):**
Start: (01:02.50) | End: (01:03.80)
"Yes, ma'am."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.20) | End: (01:09.80)
Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.

**HOUSEKEEPER (Menacing, Threatening):**
Start: (01:06.00) | End: (01:09.50)
"And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:09.80) | End: (01:13.00)
Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.

**LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Steady):**
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:12.60)
"Yes, ma'am."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.00) | End: (01:18.00)
Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.

**HOUSEKEEPER (Stern, Dismissive):**
Start: (01:13.20) | End: (01:17.50)
"Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:17.50) | End: (01:21.00)
The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.50) | End: (01:21.80)
Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.

**PRUDENCE (Relieved, Whispering):**
Start: (01:19.00) | End: (01:21.00)
"That was close."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.80) | End: (01:24.60)
Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.

**LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Quiet):**
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.50)
"Where is the West Wing?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.60) | End: (01:28.50)
Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.

logline: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from the Episode 22 cliffhanger inside the forbidden West Wing of Ashbury Manor, where Lady Juliana crouches beside the bedridden Dowager Duchess, racing against time to determine the source of her fatal illness.

scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:11.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:01.80)
Wide shot through dark draped bed curtains into the shadowy bedchamber, showing Prudence keeping watch with a single candle while Lady Juliana sits beside the grand four-poster bed.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:06.50)
Medium close-up of Prudence holding a brass candlestick with trembling hands, glancing nervously toward the doorway.

**PRUDENCE (Anxious, Whispering):**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:06.00)
"Juliana, we cannot stay for long. Someone will come."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:06.50) | End: (00:11.80)
Medium shot of Lady Juliana gently lifting the frail, trembling hands of the Dowager Duchess resting atop the linen covers.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:07.50) | End: (00:11.80)
Juliana cradles the Duchess's frail hands in hers, inspecting her fingers with furrowed brows.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.80) | End: (00:16.80)
Close-up of the Duchess's fingertips, revealing pronounced dark, purplish-black discoloration beneath the nails.

**LADY JULIANA (Hushed, Grave):**
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.00)
"How long has she been like this?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:20.00)
Medium shot of Prudence leaning against the bedpost, tears glistening in her eyes.

**PRUDENCE (Tearful, Trembling):**
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:19.50)
"Weeks."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.00) | End: (00:24.00)
High-angle two-shot as Lady Juliana leans closer over the gasping Duchess, gently touching her parched lips.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:24.00) | End: (00:27.50)
Close-up on Lady Juliana's concerned face as she withdraws her finger from the Duchess's mouth.

**LADY JULIANA (Solemn):**
Start: (00:24.00) | End: (00:27.50)
"Her mouth is terribly dry."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:31.50)
Medium shot as Lady Juliana presses her fingertips gently against the Duchess's wrist, feeling for a pulse.

**LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Grim):**
Start: (00:29.00) | End: (00:31.50)
"Her pulse is weak."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.50) | End: (00:36.00)
Close-up of Prudence holding the flickering candle, crying openly in distress.

**PRUDENCE (Despairing, Weeping):**
Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:36.00)
"The physician said her heart is failing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.00) | End: (00:38.50)
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping hoarsely for air, her throat straining as she weakly fights to breathe.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:36.00) | End: (00:38.50)
Duchess's raspy, labored inhalation.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:38.50) | End: (00:43.00)
Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing upright, her expression hardening with fierce skepticism.

**LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute):**
Start: (00:40.80) | End: (00:43.00)
"No."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:46.50)
Medium shot panning down as Juliana reaches into her deep apron pocket and pulls out a worn, leather-bound notebook.

**LADY JULIANA (Certain, Focused):**
Start: (00:43.80) | End: (00:46.50)
"This is not simply old age."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.50) | End: (00:48.00)
Quick reaction shot of Prudence staring with wide, bewildered eyes.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.00) | End: (00:53.50)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting at the foot of the bed, carefully opening the leather journal across her lap and flipping through hand-annotated botanical pages.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:53.50) | End: (00:57.50)
Close-up overhead of the yellowed parchment, showing botanical sketches of toxic herbs and handwritten diagnostic notes as Juliana's finger traces along the script.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:57.50) | End: (00:58.50)
Juliana draws in a sharp, startled breath, her eyes widening in horror.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:00.80)
Close-up of Juliana looking up from the page, stunned by her mother's written words.

**LADY JULIANA (Breathless, Reverent):**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:00.00)
"Mother."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:02.00)
Medium shot of Prudence leaning in, candle trembling.

**PRUDENCE (Urgent, Baffled):**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:02.00)
"What is it?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.00) | End: (01:09.50)
Two-shot of Juliana holding the open journal, reciting the matching symptoms to Prudence while the Duchess lies motionless in the background.

**LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Deliberate):**
Start: (01:02.00) | End: (01:08.50)
"Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:09.50) | End: (01:10.50)
Close-up of Prudence staring back in stunned disbelief.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.80)
Medium close-up of Juliana speaking with absolute certainty.

**LADY JULIANA (Serious, Chilled):**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.50)
"I have seen these symptoms before."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.80) | End: (01:16.00)
Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.

**PRUDENCE (Panicked, Shaken):**
Start: (01:13.80) | End: (01:15.80)
"What are you saying?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.00) | End: (01:18.50)
Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.50) | End: (01:21.50)
Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

**LADY JULIANA (Cold, Deadly Serious):**
Start: (01:19.00) | End: (01:21.50)
"Someone is poisoning her."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:24.50)
Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:22.50)
Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

**PRUDENCE (Muffled, Horrified):**
Start: (01:22.00) | End: (01:24.00)
"Poison?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.50) | End: (01:28.00)
Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.

**LADY JULIANA (Venomous, Resolute):**
Start: (01:26.00) | End: (01:28.00)
"Arsenic."

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:28.00) | End: (01:30.50)
Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:28.00) | End: (01:31.00)
Medium shot as the Duchess chokes and spasms on the bed; Juliana whips around immediately.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:34.50)
Medium tracking shot of Juliana rushing to the side table by the window, opening her satchel and setting out glass vials, a bowl, and dried herbal bundles.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:34.50) | End: (01:37.50)
Close-up of Prudence pleading desperately, tears flowing down her cheeks.

**PRUDENCE (Desperate, Begging):**
Start: (01:34.50) | End: (01:37.00)
"Can you save her?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:37.50) | End: (01:40.50)
Medium shot of Juliana uncorking a glass apothecary bottle as the Duchess rests behind her.

**LADY JULIANA (Focused, Resolute):**
Start: (01:37.50) | End: (01:40.00)
"I can try."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:40.50) | End: (01:44.50)
Top-down close-up of Juliana's soot-smudged hands pouring powdered activated charcoal from a vial into a stone mortar, then tossing in a pinch of crushed dried leaves.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:44.50) | End: (01:47.00)
Close-up of Juliana's hands vigorously grinding the pestle inside the stone mortar.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:44.50) | End: (01:52.00)
Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:47.00) | End: (01:52.50)
Medium close-up of Juliana grinding intensely, her brow furrowed as she speaks with urgent authority.

**LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Focused):**
Start: (01:47.50) | End: (01:52.00)
"The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly."

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:52.20) | End: (01:54.00)
Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:52.50) | End: (01:55.00)
Wide shot of the bedroom door framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess gasps in the bed.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:55.00) | End: (01:56.50)
Medium shot of Juliana freezing mid-motion, turning her head sharply toward the chamber door.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:56.50) | End: (01:58.50)
Close-up of the ornate brass door handle on the dark carved wooden door.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:58.50) | End: (02:04.50)
Close-up of Prudence staring at the door in utter terror, her face drained of all color.

**PRUDENCE (Terrified, Hoarse Whisper):**
Start: (01:58.80) | End: (02:04.00)
"Juliana... someone is coming."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:04.50) | End: (02:07.50)
Quick cut to Juliana looking back toward the bed and then toward the door, trapped with an unfinished cure.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:07.50) | End: (02:09.50)
Tight close-up of Juliana's charcoal-blackened hand clutching the glass medicine vial firmly.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (02:09.20) | End: (02:11.20)
Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:09.50) | End: (02:11.50)
Close-up on the brass door lever as it slowly rotates downward, and the heavy door cracks open inward into the room—cutting to an intense, heart-stopping cliffhanger.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 23's cliffhanger inside the West Wing bedchamber, as the brass latch turns and the door swings open to reveal an unexpected intruder confronting Lady Juliana and Prudence.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:48.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.50)
Close-up of the ornate brass handle turning slowly on the dark wooden chamber door as it swings open.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:00.20) | End: (00:03.00)
Heavy metallic click of the latch and the ominous low creak of the door hinges.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:03.50) | End: (00:06.00)
Wide shot of the dimly lit, vaulted bedchamber. Lady Juliana and Prudence stand rigid beside the heavy four-poster bed as a haughty blonde noblewoman in an elegant lavender empire-line gown enters, clutching a riding crop.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:04.00) | End: (00:06.50)
The noblewoman halts in the center of the chamber, tapping her riding crop against her gloved palm as her cold gaze sweeps across the two maids.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:06.00) | End: (00:08.50)
Medium shot of the noblewoman holding the riding crop upright, regarding Juliana with disdainful authority.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Sharp, Demanding):**
Start: (00:06.80) | End: (00:08.40)
"Who are you?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:12.20)
Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.

**LADY JULIANA (Humble, Measured):**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:12.00)
"Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.20) | End: (00:16.80)
Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Accusatory, Strict):**
Start: (00:13.00) | End: (00:16.40)
"And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:18.80)
Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:20.50)
Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:20.80)
Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.80) | End: (00:22.50)
Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.

**LADY JULIANA (Softly Defiant):**
Start: (00:20.80) | End: (00:22.20)
"I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.50) | End: (00:26.80)
Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Scoffing, Cruel):**
Start: (00:22.50) | End: (00:26.50)
"You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:28.80)
Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

**LADY JULIANA (Emphatic, Defiant):**
Start: (00:27.00) | End: (00:28.60)
"She is suffering."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.80) | End: (00:30.80)
Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Vicious, Venomous):**
Start: (00:29.00) | End: (00:30.80)
"Then let her suffer."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:32.80)
Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

**LADY JULIANA (Steely, Steadfast):**
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:32.50)
"I cannot do that."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:32.50) | End: (00:34.50)
The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:33.80)
A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:33.80) | End: (00:36.50)
Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.80) | End: (00:36.80)
Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening):**
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:36.80)
"You are a maid."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.80) | End: (00:38.80)
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing):**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:38.80)
"Not a physician. Not a lady."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:43.00)
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final):**
Start: (00:39.00) | End: (00:42.80)
"And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:45.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

**LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled):**
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:44.80)
"Yes, my lady."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:48.50)
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending):**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:48.00)
"Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place."

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. MANOR HEARTH ROOM – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. MANOR HEARTH ROOM – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:48.50
Scene end: 01:32.00

Actions and dialogue:

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:51.50)
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:51.50)
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:53.50)
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:54.00)
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Harsh, Dismissive):**
Start: (00:53.60) | End: (00:55.20)
"Clean it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (00:56.20)
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:56.20) | End: (00:57.80)
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

**LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Questioning):**
Start: (00:56.20) | End: (00:57.60)
"All of it, my lady?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:57.80) | End: (01:03.80)
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Intimate, Venomous):**
Start: (00:57.80) | End: (01:03.50)
"Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:03.80) | End: (01:06.00)
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:03.80) | End: (01:06.20)
Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:06.00) | End: (01:07.50)
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.20) | End: (01:07.80)
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

**PRUDENCE (Desperate, Pleading):**
Start: (01:06.20) | End: (01:07.50)
"My lady—"

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:09.50)
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.80) | End: (01:10.50)
Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Furious, Threatening):**
Start: (01:08.00) | End: (01:10.50)
"Do you want the same punishment?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:12.80)
Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

**PRUDENCE (Terrified, Murmuring):**
Start: (01:10.60) | End: (01:12.40)
"No, my lady."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:12.50) | End: (01:14.50)
Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:12.80) | End: (01:14.80)
Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:13.00) | End: (01:21.00)
Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:18.50)
Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Gleeful):**
Start: (01:15.00) | End: (01:18.00)
"That is where clever little servants belong."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.50) | End: (01:21.20)
Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

**LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Cold, Resolute):**
Start: (01:18.60) | End: (01:21.00)
"Let her think I am only a maid."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:21.20) | End: (01:25.00)
Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.20) | End: (01:25.20)
Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.

**LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Determined, Defiant):**
Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:24.80)
"Let her believe I am ignorant."

**ACTION:**

logline: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately following Juliana's ordeal at Ashburg Manor, where she escaped punishment after hiding the antidote and now encounters Alexander awaiting her on the woodland trail.

**CAMERA:**

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.60) | End: (00:04.20)
Juliana walks hurriedly along the leaf-strewn forest path, clutching her dark hooded cloak tightly around her shoulders, breathing heavily.

**CAMERA:**

Start: (00:14.90) | End: (00:16.10)
"You're hurt."
