Start: (00:16.20) | End: (00:18.80)
Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.

**JULIANA (Strained, Minimizing):**
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:18.50)
"It is nothing."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:22.50)
Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:22.80)
Tight close-up of the fresh riding-crop laceration cut across Juliana's shoulder.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.80) | End: (00:25.80)
Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.

**ALEXANDER (Seething, Dangerous):**
Start: (00:24.00) | End: (00:25.50)
"Who did this?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:25.80) | End: (00:29.80)
Medium close-up of Juliana averting her eyes, her head bowed in quiet resignation.

**JULIANA (Subdued, Weary):**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:29.30)
"It does not matter."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.80)
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:34.50)
Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.

**ALEXANDER (Demanding, Stern):**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:33.80)
"Who?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.50) | End: (00:38.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, whispering the truth.

**JULIANA (Quiet, Apprehensive):**
Start: (00:36.00) | End: (00:37.80)
"Lady Catherine."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:38.50) | End: (00:41.20)
Close-up of Alexander, his gaze piercing and hard.

**ALEXANDER (Low, Interrogating):**
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:41.00)
"Where did you meet her?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:44.40)
Close-up of Juliana recounting the incident.

**JULIANA (Hedged):**
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:44.20)
"I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:44.40) | End: (00:46.80)
Close-up of Alexander, pressing her without hesitation.

**ALEXANDER (Incredulous, Demanding):**
Start: (00:44.60) | End: (00:46.40)
"What were you doing there?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:51.50)
Medium two-shot of Alexander leaning down toward her against the dim forest backdrop.

**ALEXANDER (Fierce, Urgent):**
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:51.20)
"Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:54.20)
Close-up of Juliana holding his gaze resolutely.

**JULIANA (Earnest):**
Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:54.20)
"I went there to help someone."

**ALEXANDER (Blunt):**
Start: (00:54.40) | End: (00:55.20)
"Who?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.50) | End: (00:57.50)
Medium close-up profile of both of them locked in stillness.

**JULIANA (Solemn):**
Start: (00:55.60) | End: (00:57.20)
"The Dowager Duchess."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:57.50) | End: (01:03.50)
Tight close-up of Alexander's face freezing in shock, his eyes widening as the revelation hits him.

**ALEXANDER (Stunned, Disbelieving):**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:02.50)
"The Dowager?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:03.50) | End: (01:08.50)
Medium profile tracking shot as Juliana begins walking slowly along the trail, Alexander following closely by her side.

**JULIANA (Urgent):**
Start: (01:06.20) | End: (01:08.50)
"Prudence told me she was dying."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:08.50) | End: (01:13.80)
Medium close-up of Juliana turning toward him, recounting the scene in the bedchamber.

**JULIANA (Fervent):**
Start: (01:08.80) | End: (01:13.80)
"She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.80) | End: (01:16.80)
Two-shot as Juliana stops and looks up into Alexander's grim expression.

**JULIANA (Chilling, Definite):**
Start: (01:14.20) | End: (01:15.80)
"But it wasn't age."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:19.50)
Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.

**ALEXANDER (Grim, Low):**
Start: (01:17.40) | End: (01:18.90)
"What did you find?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:19.50) | End: (01:22.50)
Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.

**JULIANA (Hushed, Horrified):**
Start: (01:20.20) | End: (01:21.80)
"Poison."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:26.20)
Slightly wider close-up as Juliana's eyes well with distress.

**JULIANA (Sober):**
Start: (01:23.50) | End: (01:25.00)
"Arsenic."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:26.20) | End: (01:30.00)
Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.20) | End: (01:30.20)
Close-up on Alexander's fist clenching tightly in fury.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:30.20) | End: (01:37.80)
Medium close-up of Juliana, her voice filled with mounting dread.

**JULIANA (Pained, Troubled):**
Start: (01:30.20) | End: (01:37.40)
"Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:37.80) | End: (01:40.20)
Close-up of Alexander processing the sinister calculation behind the poisoning.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:40.20) | End: (01:45.20)
Two-shot as Juliana looks up at him with quiet hope.

**JULIANA (Sincere, Earnest):**
Start: (01:40.40) | End: (01:44.80)
"I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:45.20) | End: (01:47.80)
Close-up of Alexander's startled gaze.

**ALEXANDER (Incredulous):**
Start: (01:45.60) | End: (01:47.00)
"You treated her?"

**JULIANA (Firm):**
Start: (01:47.20) | End: (01:48.00)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:47.80) | End: (01:51.80)
Close-up profile of the two facing each other.

**ALEXANDER (Tense):**
Start: (01:48.40) | End: (01:49.40)
"Alone?"

**JULIANA (Soft):**
Start: (01:49.80) | End: (01:51.20)
"With Prudence."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:51.80) | End: (01:54.80)
Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowed with deep protective worry.

**ALEXANDER (Anxious):**
Start: (01:52.20) | End: (01:54.40)
"Will you be going there again?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:54.80) | End: (01:57.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with resolute purpose.

**JULIANA (Determined):**
Start: (01:55.20) | End: (01:56.80)
"I have to."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:57.50) | End: (02:01.00)
Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:57.50) | End: (02:01.50)
Two-shot of Juliana leaning in, her hand resting over Alexander's coat.

**JULIANA (Pleading, Defiant):**
Start: (01:57.50) | End: (02:00.20)
"She is still sick. I cannot leave her there."

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:01.00) | End: (02:05.00)
Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:01.50) | End: (02:05.50)
Medium two-shot of Alexander holding Juliana's hands in the dusky woods.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:05.50) | End: (02:08.00)
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his darkened face with questioning concern.

**JULIANA (Gentle, Perplexed):**
Start: (02:05.80) | End: (02:07.50)
"Alexander... why are you so angry?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:08.00) | End: (02:14.50)
Close-up of Alexander speaking through clenched teeth, barely containing his protective fury.

**ALEXANDER (Fierce, Reproachful):**
Start: (02:08.20) | End: (02:13.80)
"Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:17.20)
Medium shot of Juliana looking down sheepishly before raising her eyes.

**JULIANA (Vulnerable):**
Start: (02:15.00) | End: (02:17.00)
"I knew you would worry."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:17.20) | End: (02:22.00)
Tight close-up of Alexander, his voice trembling with terrified passion.

**ALEXANDER (Furious, Tormented):**
Start: (02:17.40) | End: (02:22.40)
"Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:22.00) | End: (02:25.00)
Two-shot as Juliana looks up into his eyes, holding firm.

**JULIANA (Defiant, Soothing):**
Start: (02:23.20) | End: (02:24.60)
"But they didn't."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:25.00) | End: (02:28.50)
Close-up of their clasped hands, panning up to Alexander's tormented gaze.

**ALEXANDER (Grim, Fearful):**
Start: (02:25.20) | End: (02:26.40)
"This time."

**JULIANA (Sincere, Steadfast):**
Start: (02:27.00) | End: (02:28.80)
"I am being careful."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:28.50) | End: (02:32.00)
Two-shot as Juliana looks at him earnestly.

**JULIANA (Resolute):**
Start: (02:29.00) | End: (02:31.20)
"I cannot abandon her."

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:31.20) | End: (02:34.00)
Alexander closes his eyes for a brief, agonizing second, exhaling deeply as he yields to her unshakeable conviction.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:32.00) | End: (02:36.50)
Close-up of Alexander opening his piercing eyes, resignation and steadfast devotion washing over his features.

**ALEXANDER (Resigned, Steely):**
Start: (02:33.80) | End: (02:36.20)
"Then tell me everything."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:36.50) | End: (02:43.00)
Medium two-shot as Alexander holds her gaze in the twilight shadows.

**ALEXANDER (Low, Uncompromising):**
Start: (02:37.40) | End: (02:39.20)
"Everything you saw."

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:42.50) | End: (02:48.00)
Alexander turns, falling into step beside Juliana. Together, side by side, they begin their quiet walk down the darkening forest path into the twilight.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:43.00) | End: (02:48.00)
Wide tracking shot from behind Alexander and Juliana as their silhouettes disappear into the shadowy, mist-veiled forest as emotional strings swell to a resolving chord.

logline: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
continuity_notes: Following her encounter with Alexander in the forest where she vowed to protect the Duchess, Juliana sneaks into the bedchamber at Ashburg Manor to deliver the remaining antidote before Rupert and Catherine's poison takes full hold.

scenes.heading: INT. DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:00.88

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.80)
Wide shot framed through heavy bed curtains in a dark, candlelit bedchamber. Juliana in her maid's apron sits vigilantly beside the canopied bed where the frail Dowager Duchess lies.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.50)
Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.80) | End: (00:10.50)
Close-up of Juliana's hands unscrewing the glass dropper from a small amber medicine bottle filled with dark medicinal liquid.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:06.50) | End: (00:09.00)
Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:14.20)
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess resting against pale pillows as her heavy eyelids slowly open, her gaze weak and disoriented.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:11.00) | End: (00:14.00)
The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:14.20) | End: (00:20.50)
Low-angle medium two-shot looking past Juliana's silhouette down to the Duchess in bed.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Raspy):**
Start: (00:14.20) | End: (00:20.20)
"Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:25.80)
Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.

**JULIANA (Urgent, Reassuring):**
Start: (00:20.60) | End: (00:25.40)
"Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:25.80) | End: (00:28.50)
Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:25.80) | End: (00:28.40)
The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.50) | End: (00:30.80)
Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:35.80)
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Faint, Discerning):**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:35.50)
"You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:40.20)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.

**JULIANA (Humble, Sincere):**
Start: (00:36.00) | End: (00:39.80)
"I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:40.20) | End: (00:43.20)
Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.

**JULIANA (Gentle, Calming):**
Start: (00:40.30) | End: (00:43.00)
"Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:47.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.

**JULIANA (Hushed, Tense Whisper):**
Start: (00:43.50) | End: (00:47.00)
"If the guards hear us, we are both dead."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:47.50) | End: (00:50.80)
Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:50.80) | End: (00:55.80)
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:55.50)
The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.80) | End: (01:02.50)
Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Heartbroken):**
Start: (00:56.00) | End: (01:02.00)
"Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.50) | End: (01:07.00)
Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.

**JULIANA (Reassuring, Steadfast):**
Start: (01:02.60) | End: (01:06.70)
"Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:11.80)
Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.80) | End: (01:19.60)
Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Curious, Searching):**
Start: (01:13.80) | End: (01:19.40)
"Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:19.60) | End: (01:26.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.

**JULIANA (Painful, Proud):**
Start: (01:20.00) | End: (01:25.80)
"Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:30.80)
Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:27.00) | End: (01:30.50)
Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:30.20) | End: (01:32.00)
A sharp, stunned gasp.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:30.80) | End: (01:35.00)
Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:30.80) | End: (01:35.00)
The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:35.00) | End: (01:40.00)
Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Breathless, Shaken):**
Start: (01:36.00) | End: (01:39.80)
"Your hand... Let me see your hand."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:40.00) | End: (01:45.50)
Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.

**JULIANA (Confused, Alarmed):**
Start: (01:40.50) | End: (01:45.00)
"Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:45.50) | End: (01:49.00)
Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:46.00) | End: (01:49.00)
The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:50.00)
A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:49.00) | End: (01:50.80)
Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Stern, Desperate):**
Start: (01:49.20) | End: (01:50.60)

scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:30.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.10)
Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Breathless):**
Start: (00:01.30) | End: (00:03.20)
"This ring..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:02.10) | End: (00:05.80)
Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Urgent, Demanding):**
Start: (00:03.40) | End: (00:05.80)
"Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.80) | End: (00:09.40)
Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.

**JULIANA (Hesitant, Sincere):**
Start: (00:06.40) | End: (00:09.30)
"My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.40) | End: (00:13.20)
Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Incredulous, Intense):**
Start: (00:09.70) | End: (00:12.80)
"He is no commoner. What does he do?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.20) | End: (00:16.80)
Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.

**JULIANA (Earnest, Defending):**
Start: (00:13.40) | End: (00:16.40)
"He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:21.60)
Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Revelatory):**
Start: (00:17.20) | End: (00:21.20)
"That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.60) | End: (00:26.10)
Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.

**JULIANA (Confused, Gentle):**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:25.80)
"No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.10) | End: (00:31.80)
Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Emotionally Strained, Weeping):**
Start: (00:26.60) | End: (00:31.40)
"My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.80) | End: (00:34.90)
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

**JULIANA (Shocked, Breathless):**
Start: (00:32.10) | End: (00:34.80)
"Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.90) | End: (00:37.40)
Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Clinging):**
Start: (00:35.20) | End: (00:37.60)
"My lost son wore that ring!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.40) | End: (00:40.40)
Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Pleading):**
Start: (00:37.80) | End: (00:40.20)
"Did your husband serve beside him?"

**JULIANA (Soft, Reverent):**
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:44.20)
"He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:44.20) | End: (00:46.40)
Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hushed, Desperate):**
Start: (00:44.50) | End: (00:46.40)
"What is your husband's name?"

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:46.40) | End: (00:48.30)
Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.50) | End: (00:48.80)
Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:48.80) | End: (00:51.50)
The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.80) | End: (00:51.50)
Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:55.60)
Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

**LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Accusatory):**
Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:55.60)
"What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.60) | End: (00:58.60)
Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.

**JULIANA (Calm, Defiant):**
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:58.40)
"She needed help."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.60) | End: (01:02.00)
Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.

**LADY CATHERINE (Piercing, Suspicious):**
Start: (01:00.00) | End: (01:01.80)
"What are you hiding?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.00) | End: (01:04.00)
Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.

**JULIANA (Firm):**
Start: (01:02.20) | End: (01:03.50)
"Nothing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.00) | End: (01:06.50)
Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.

**LADY CATHERINE (Demanding, Harsh):**
Start: (01:04.80) | End: (01:06.40)
"Show me your hand."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.50) | End: (01:10.50)
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative):**
Start: (01:06.60) | End: (01:10.10)
"Girl. Show me what you are holding."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.80)
Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical):**
Start: (01:12.60) | End: (01:13.70)
"What is this?"

**JULIANA (Steady):**
Start: (01:13.80) | End: (01:14.80)
"Medicine."

continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 27 as Rupert orders the guard to seize Juliana, ignoring the waking Duchess.

scenes.heading: INT. DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:18.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.30)
Medium shot as the guard drags Juliana toward the doorway, wrestling her backward.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.10)
Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:03.20)
Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:02.30) | End: (00:04.70)
Low-angle close-up of the leather-bound herbarium on the floor as Catherine's silk slipper steps down hard upon its embossed cover.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:03.20) | End: (00:04.60)
Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.70) | End: (00:10.00)
Medium two-shot tracking Catherine as she strides gracefully across the chamber toward Juliana, Rupert standing stoically behind her near the bed.

**CATHERINE (Mocking, Cruel):**
Start: (00:04.90) | End: (00:06.30)
"Look at her, Rupert."

**CATHERINE (Scoffing):**
Start: (00:06.60) | End: (00:08.10)
"Soot on her face..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.20) | End: (00:12.60)
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Catherine as she faces Juliana, who is pinned in the doorway by the guard.

**CATHERINE (Accusing, Smug):**
Start: (00:08.40) | End: (00:10.00)
"...herbs in her pockets..."

**CATHERINE (Cold):**
Start: (00:10.20) | End: (00:12.30)
"...a secret medicine in her hand."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.60) | End: (00:15.20)
Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.

**CATHERINE (Venomous):**
Start: (00:12.70) | End: (00:15.00)
"She looks exactly like a poisoner."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.20) | End: (00:18.50)
Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.

**JULIANA (Furious, Defiant):**
Start: (00:15.30) | End: (00:18.40)
"I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.50) | End: (00:22.80)
Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sardonic, Chilling):**
Start: (00:18.90) | End: (00:20.30)
"A clever story, girl."

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Threatening):**
Start: (00:20.40) | End: (00:22.70)
"But the guards know how to extract the truth."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.80) | End: (00:26.70)
Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining):**
Start: (00:24.80) | End: (00:26.50)
"Rupert..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.70) | End: (00:28.40)
Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Commanding):**
Start: (00:26.70) | End: (00:28.20)
"Stop this!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.40) | End: (00:32.80)
Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm):**
Start: (00:28.80) | End: (00:30.30)
"She is innocent."

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant):**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:32.40)
"She saved me!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:34.90)
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

**JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved):**
Start: (00:33.20) | End: (00:34.60)
"Your Grace..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.90) | End: (00:37.70)
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting):**
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:37.40)
"I know what happened to me!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.70) | End: (00:43.00)
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning):**
Start: (00:38.20) | End: (00:40.00)
"I was poisoned!"

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing):**
Start: (00:40.30) | End: (00:42.20)
"And you... you knew!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:47.40)
Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Choking, Weakening):**
Start: (00:43.60) | End: (00:45.30)
"Catherine knew!"

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Gasping):**
Start: (00:45.60) | End: (00:47.00)
"They have been—"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:48.00)
The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:47.40) | End: (00:52.20)
Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

**JULIANA (Panicked, Screaming):**
Start: (00:48.20) | End: (00:49.70)
"Let me help her!"

**JULIANA (Desperate):**
Start: (00:49.50) | End: (00:52.10)
"She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:56.80)
Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Feigning Concern):**
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:53.60)
"You see?"

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sinister):**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (00:56.60)
"The poison has clearly damaged her mind."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (01:01.30)
Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hoarse, Straining):**
Start: (00:57.00) | End: (00:58.70)
"I am not delusional!"

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condescending, Whispering):**
Start: (00:58.60) | End: (01:00.00)
"Of course you are not."

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive):**
Start: (01:00.10) | End: (01:01.20)
"You are merely confused."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:01.30) | End: (01:06.80)
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

**CATHERINE (Amused, Mocking):**
Start: (01:01.60) | End: (01:04.80)
"How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."

**CATHERINE (Smug):**
Start: (01:04.90) | End: (01:06.80)
"...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.50)
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Commanding, Resolute):**
Start: (01:07.20) | End: (01:10.20)
"Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:12.00)
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:10.80) | End: (01:12.00)
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

**JULIANA (Crying Out):**
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:12.00)
"No!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:12.00) | End: (01:15.30)
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

**CATHERINE (Insolent, Sneering):**
Start: (01:12.20) | End: (01:15.10)
"Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:15.30) | End: (01:18.90)
Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

**JULIANA (Screaming, Weeping):**
Start: (01:15.40) | End: (01:16.40)
"Give it back!"

**JULIANA (Anguished):**
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:18.60)
"It belonged to my mother!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.90) | End: (01:22.30)
Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

**CATHERINE (O.S.) (Cruel):**
Start: (01:19.00) | End: (01:21.90)
"A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows."

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:21.00) | End: (01:22.40)
Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:22.30) | End: (01:26.50)
Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

**JULIANA (Heartbroken):**
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.40)
"My mother's locket!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:31.00)
Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:28.00) | End: (01:31.00)
Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:33.80)
Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

**CATHERINE (Intrigued, Murmuring):**
Start: (01:31.20) | End: (01:32.80)
"Juliana..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:33.80) | End: (01:35.00)
Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:35.00) | End: (01:37.40)
Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:35.20) | End: (01:37.00)
Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:37.40) | End: (01:41.20)
Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

**CATHERINE (Triumphant, Venomous):**
Start: (01:38.20) | End: (01:40.80)
"Lady Juliana Ashcroft."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:47.80)
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

**CATHERINE (Mocking, Reveling):**
Start: (01:41.50) | End: (01:43.70)
"I knew I had seen those eyes before."

**CATHERINE (Cruel):**
Start: (01:44.20) | End: (01:45.60)
"The disgraced daughter..."

**CATHERINE (Scornful):**

timeline_events.label: CAMERA

timeline_events.text: "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking)

timeline_events.text: "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."

timeline_events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Harsh, Authoritative)

timeline_events.text: "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."

timeline_events.text: Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "And this?"

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Gleeful)

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate)

source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-029-Episode 1678582.txt
logline: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 28 where Rupert ordered the guards to drag Juliana down to the wet cells while Catherine seized her mother's herbarium.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. CASTLE DUNGEON STAIRWELL – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. CASTLE DUNGEON STAIRWELL – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:20.10

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.80)
High angle tracking shot descending a spiral stone staircase illuminated by flickering wall torches and damp, glistening masonry.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.50)
Dripping water echoes hollowly against stone steps alongside the shuffling scuffle of boots.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:02.80) | End: (00:05.10)
Tracking shot facing two stern uniform guards hauling a struggling Juliana down the dark corridor by her arms.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:02.90) | End: (00:05.10)
Juliana resists furiously, her feet stumbling on the wet flagstones as the guards forcibly propel her forward.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.10) | End: (00:07.40)
Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.40) | End: (00:11.70)
Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.

**JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping):**
Start: (00:07.40) | End: (00:11.70)
"Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.70) | End: (00:13.20)
Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.20) | End: (00:17.30)
Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.

**JULIANA (Pleading, Agonized):**
Start: (00:13.20) | End: (00:17.30)
"It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.30) | End: (00:20.10)
Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. DUNGEON CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. DUNGEON CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:20.10
Scene end: 01:23.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.10) | End: (00:26.80)
Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.

**CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending):**
Start: (00:21.00) | End: (00:24.00)
"Your mother's little book of weeds?"

**CATHERINE (Cruel, Smug):**
Start: (00:24.80) | End: (00:26.70)
"You still call this a legacy?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:28.90)
Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.

**JULIANA (Defiant, Furious):**
Start: (00:27.10) | End: (00:28.70)
"It is medicine!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.90) | End: (00:31.90)
Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.

**CATHERINE (Smooth, Patronizing):**
Start: (00:30.40) | End: (00:31.80)
"Of course."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.90) | End: (00:37.40)
Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.

**CATHERINE (O.S.) (Disdainful, Calculating):**
Start: (00:31.90) | End: (00:37.30)
"Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.40) | End: (00:40.00)
Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.

**CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening):**
Start: (00:37.70) | End: (00:40.00)
"The magistrate will call it witchcraft."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:40.00) | End: (00:41.90)
Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.

**JULIANA (Furious, Shouted):**
Start: (00:40.10) | End: (00:41.80)
"You know that is a lie!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:41.90) | End: (00:44.30)
Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.

**CATHERINE (Calm, Sinister):**
Start: (00:42.00) | End: (00:44.20)
"I know exactly what I need him to believe."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:44.30) | End: (00:46.90)
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.

**JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate):**
Start: (00:44.40) | End: (00:46.50)
"You cannot just destroy it!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.90) | End: (00:49.80)
Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.

**CATHERINE (Whispered, Malicious):**
Start: (00:47.30) | End: (00:49.10)
"I can burn it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.80) | End: (00:53.60)
Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.

**CATHERINE (O.S.) (Chilling, Relentless):**
Start: (00:50.10) | End: (00:53.60)
"And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:53.60) | End: (00:56.60)
Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.

**CATHERINE (Cruel, Resolute):**
Start: (00:53.80) | End: (00:56.50)
"...no one will remember what was written inside."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:56.60) | End: (00:59.20)
Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.

**JULIANA (Enraged, Defiant):**
Start: (00:56.70) | End: (00:59.00)
"You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.20) | End: (01:03.80)
Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.

**CATHERINE (Scornful, Arrogant):**
Start: (00:59.30) | End: (01:03.40)
"I am doing this because women like you forget their place."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:03.80) | End: (01:07.00)
Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.

**CATHERINE (Cold, Venomous):**
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.50)
"You were cast out once."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:09.50)
Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.

**CATHERINE (Menacing):**
Start: (01:07.20) | End: (01:09.10)
"You should have stayed forgotten."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:09.50) | End: (01:11.80)
Close-up of Juliana raising her chin, unwavering pride breaking through her tears.

**JULIANA (Steely, Resolute):**
Start: (01:09.80) | End: (01:11.40)
"My husband will find me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.80) | End: (01:14.30)
Medium shot of Catherine letting out a scornful laugh, tilting her head.

**CATHERINE (Scoffing, Amused):**
Start: (01:12.10) | End: (01:14.30)
"Your scarred soldier?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.30) | End: (01:18.50)
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into sharp mockery.

**CATHERINE (Derisive, Biting):**
Start: (01:14.70) | End: (01:18.10)
"What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.50) | End: (01:20.90)
Medium shot as the guard clamps a heavy hand on Juliana's shoulder, shoving her forward.

**GUARD (Gruff, Dismissive):**
Start: (01:18.70) | End: (01:20.60)
"Move along, girl."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:20.90) | End: (01:23.00)
Wide shot tracking behind the guards as they march Juliana down the vaulted, puddle-strewn corridor toward the heavy iron cell door.

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: INT. CASTLE DUNGEON CELL – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: INT. CASTLE DUNGEON CELL – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 01:23.00
Scene end: 01:56.69

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:23.00) | End: (01:26.50)
Wide shot inside the pitch-dark cell as the heavy iron door swings open.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:24.00) | End: (01:26.50)
The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.

**JULIANA (Crying Out, Broken):**
Start: (01:25.70) | End: (01:26.50)
"Please!"

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:28.00)
The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:28.80)
Static shot of the locked iron door, deadlocked in total isolation.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:28.80) | End: (01:33.70)
Medium close-up of Juliana kneeling on the floor, clutching her chest as hyperventilation overtakes her.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:29.50) | End: (01:33.70)
Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:33.70) | End: (01:36.10)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's tear-drenched face crumpling in overwhelming grief.

**JULIANA (Sobbing, Heartbroken):**
Start: (01:34.20) | End: (01:35.50)
"Mother..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:36.10) | End: (01:39.60)
Medium shot as Juliana pushes herself off the wet stone floor and dashes toward the barred wicket of the heavy door.

**JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting):**
Start: (01:37.30) | End: (01:39.50)
"I have done nothing!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.60) | End: (01:42.50)
Tight profile close-up of Juliana gripping the rusted iron bars, screaming out into the empty stone corridor.

**JULIANA (Screaming, Hysterical):**
Start: (01:39.70) | End: (01:42.30)
"I saved her! I healed her!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:42.50) | End: (01:45.90)
Medium shot from inside the cell as Juliana pounds her fists rhythmically against the reinforced iron door.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:42.50) | End: (01:45.20)
Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.

**JULIANA (Shouting in Anguish):**
Start: (01:42.60) | End: (01:45.30)
"I saved the Duchess!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:45.90) | End: (01:49.00)
Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.

**JULIANA (V.O.) (Sorrowful, Wounded):**
Start: (01:46.50) | End: (01:48.80)
"They took my mother's ledger..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:49.00) | End: (01:52.80)
Front medium shot of Juliana slowly rising to her feet, crossing her arms firmly across her chest as her tears stop and her expression hardens into steely resolve.

**JULIANA (V.O.) (Quiet Resolve, Unbreakable):**
Start: (01:49.00) | End: (01:52.60)
"They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:52.80) | End: (01:55.50)
Close-up of the dungeon's massive iron portcullis bars dropping down with finality.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:52.80) | End: (01:54.80)
A heavy iron portcullis crashes down with a massive echoing bang.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:55.50) | End: (01:56.69)
Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana standing dignified in the center of the damp dungeon cell, gazing upward toward the overhead grate where faint beams of moonlight filter down, cutting sharply to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her.

scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. CASTLE CORRIDOR – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:47.60

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.20)
Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.50)
Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:03.00) | End: (00:05.50)
The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.20) | End: (00:07.50)
Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:06.80) | End: (00:07.90)
A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.50) | End: (00:13.50)
Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory):**
Start: (00:08.80) | End: (00:13.30)
"You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.90)
Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

**RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious):**
Start: (00:13.60) | End: (00:16.80)
"The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.90) | End: (00:26.00)
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving):**
Start: (00:17.30) | End: (00:25.80)
"The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.00) | End: (00:29.80)
Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

**RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid):**
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:29.20)
"She knows the Duchess was poisoned."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.00)
Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:33.40)
Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

**RUPERT (Fearful):**
Start: (00:32.10) | End: (00:33.30)
"If she speaks..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.40) | End: (00:39.80)
Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:33.40) | End: (00:35.20)
The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous):**
Start: (00:33.60) | End: (00:39.80)
"Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:43.80)
Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

**RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive):**
Start: (00:41.80) | End: (00:43.50)
"What are you suggesting?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.80) | End: (00:47.60)
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous):**
Start: (00:44.80) | End: (00:47.30)
"We stop hiding the prisoner."

timeline_events.text: "And the Dowager?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-030-Episode 1678583.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-030-Episode 1678583.txt

timeline_events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)

timeline_events.text: "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-030-Episode 1678583.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA

timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-030-Episode 1678583.txt

timeline_events.label: RUPERT (Hesitant)
timeline_events.speaker: RUPERT
timeline_events.text: "And Juliana?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-030-Episode 1678583.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.

timeline_events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute)

timeline_events.text: "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-030-Episode 1678583.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant)

timeline_events.label: RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful)

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.

timeline_events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive)

timeline_events.text: "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."

logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:40.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.80)
Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.80)
Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:02.80) | End: (00:04.20)
Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:02.80) | End: (00:04.20)
Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.20) | End: (00:09.50)
Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.

**CATHERINE (Cruel, Condescending):**
Start: (00:06.90) | End: (00:08.80)
"Look at you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.50) | End: (00:10.50)
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:13.80)
Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.

**CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous):**
Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:13.80)
"The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:17.60)
Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.

**CATHERINE (Taunting):**
Start: (00:14.00) | End: (00:17.60)
"Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.60) | End: (00:20.80)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.

**JULIANA (Defiant, Steady):**
Start: (00:17.80) | End: (00:20.50)
"You seem very pleased."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.80) | End: (00:24.50)
Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.

**CATHERINE (Smug, Chilling):**
Start: (00:21.00) | End: (00:23.50)
"I am."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:24.50) | End: (00:29.00)
Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.

**CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister):**
Start: (00:25.00) | End: (00:28.90)
"Because this is what you were always meant to be."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.00) | End: (00:34.80)
Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.

**CATHERINE (Scornful):**
Start: (00:29.30) | End: (00:34.80)
"Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.80) | End: (00:39.00)
Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

**CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful):**
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:38.90)
"[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:39.00) | End: (00:43.00)
Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

**JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken):**
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:43.00)
"I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:48.50)
Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

**CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter):**
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:48.50)
"No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:54.80)
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

**CATHERINE (Gloating):**
Start: (00:48.90) | End: (00:50.80)
"Do you remember?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.00)
Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

**CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted):**
Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:54.80)
"Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:59.00)
Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:55.20) | End: (00:57.50)
Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.

**CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous):**
Start: (00:55.50) | End: (00:58.80)
"And everyone watched you walk away alone."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.00) | End: (01:05.50)
Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.

**JULIANA (Proud, Measured):**
Start: (00:59.20) | End: (01:01.30)
"Gerald chose money."

**JULIANA (Resolute):**
Start: (01:01.50) | End: (01:03.50)
"Clarissa chose a coward."

**JULIANA (Unyielding):**
Start: (01:03.80) | End: (01:05.30)
"I chose myself."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:05.50) | End: (01:07.50)
Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.

**CATHERINE (Disgusted):**
Start: (01:05.60) | End: (01:07.40)
"You chose a beggar."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:10.50)
Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.

**JULIANA (Fierce, Proud):**
Start: (01:07.60) | End: (01:09.80)
"I chose a man."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.30)
Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.

**CATHERINE (Contemptuous):**
Start: (01:10.80) | End: (01:13.20)
"A scarred nobody."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.30) | End: (01:17.60)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.

**JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified):**
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:17.60)
"A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:17.60) | End: (01:20.50)
Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

**CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking):**
Start: (01:17.80) | End: (01:20.20)
"You call that marriage?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:20.50) | End: (01:23.20)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.

**JULIANA (Pure, Sincere):**
Start: (01:20.80) | End: (01:23.20)
"I call it love."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:23.20) | End: (01:28.00)
High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

**CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh):**
Start: (01:23.50) | End: (01:27.40)
"[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:31.20)
Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

**JULIANA (Firm, Piercing):**
Start: (01:27.80) | End: (01:31.20)
"To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:31.20) | End: (01:34.20)
Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

**CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended):**
Start: (01:31.40) | End: (01:34.20)
"You think love makes you better than me?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:34.20) | End: (01:38.20)
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

**JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):**
Start: (01:34.50) | End: (01:38.20)
"No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:38.20) | End: (01:43.50)
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

**CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful):**
Start: (01:38.50) | End: (01:43.30)
"I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:43.50) | End: (01:48.80)
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

**JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful):**
Start: (01:43.70) | End: (01:48.50)
"Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:50.50)
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

**CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive):**
Start: (01:50.20) | End: (01:51.40)
"[scoffs] Peasants? People?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:51.50) | End: (01:58.20)
Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.

**CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist):**
Start: (01:51.60) | End: (01:58.20)
"That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:58.20) | End: (02:02.50)
Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.

**JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative):**
Start: (01:58.40) | End: (02:02.00)
"Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:02.00) | End: (02:04.00)
Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:04.00) | End: (02:10.80)
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.

**JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding):**
Start: (02:04.20) | End: (02:10.50)
"If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:10.80) | End: (02:13.00)
Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.

**CATHERINE (Enraged Scream):**
Start: (02:11.00) | End: (02:12.80)
"Enough!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:13.00) | End: (02:14.50)
Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (02:13.20) | End: (02:14.50)
Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:18.00)
Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.

**CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious):**
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:18.00)
"This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:18.00) | End: (02:20.50)
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:18.00) | End: (02:20.50)
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

**JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping):**
Start: (02:18.40) | End: (02:20.40)
"[gasping] Give it back!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:23.80)
Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.

**CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic):**
Start: (02:20.70) | End: (02:23.80)
"There. Finally. Something still hurts you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:23.80) | End: (02:25.50)
Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.

**JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized):**
Start: (02:24.00) | End: (02:25.50)
"No!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:25.50) | End: (02:31.20)
Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.

**CATHERINE (Vicious, Final):**
Start: (02:25.60) | End: (02:31.20)
"One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:31.20) | End: (02:35.20)
Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:31.50) | End: (02:35.20)
Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:35.20) | End: (02:40.00)
Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.

--- SCRIPT END ---

"Fear."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.50) | End: (00:10.50)
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.

**CATHERINE (Taunting):**
Start: (00:09.80) | End: (00:13.20)
"You have been so proud of that brave little face..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:13.50)
Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.

**CATHERINE (Smug, Dominant):**
Start: (00:13.40) | End: (00:15.80)
"...but now you are afraid."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.00)
Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.00) | End: (00:17.00)
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

**CATHERINE (Cruel, Final):**
Start: (00:16.20) | End: (00:18.80)
"Say goodbye to your mother."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.00) | End: (00:19.00)
Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:20.50)
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.00) | End: (00:20.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

**JULIANA (Defiant, Unbroken):**
Start: (00:20.20) | End: (00:22.00)
"Burn it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:23.00)
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.00) | End: (00:25.50)
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

**CATHERINE (Disconcerted):**
Start: (00:23.80) | End: (00:24.80)
"What?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:25.50) | End: (00:28.50)
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

**JULIANA (Firm, Resolute):**
Start: (00:25.80) | End: (00:28.80)
"Burn the ledger. Burn every page."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.50) | End: (00:30.80)
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

**JULIANA (Steely, Proud):**
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.80)
"You may destroy the book..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:33.50)
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.50) | End: (00:36.50)
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

**JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant):**
Start: (00:33.20) | End: (00:36.20)
"...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.40) | End: (00:38.80)
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

**CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing):**
Start: (00:36.40) | End: (00:39.10)
"You think a few herbs make you better than me?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:41.00)
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

**JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):**
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:42.80)
"No. Your cruelty does that for me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:43.50)
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.50) | End: (00:45.50)
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

**CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting):**
Start: (00:43.40) | End: (00:45.40)
"You still think you are better?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:47.80)
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

**JULIANA (Serene, Grounded):**
Start: (00:45.60) | End: (00:47.40)
"I know what I am."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:49.00)
Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

**CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking):**
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:49.00)
"A disgraced woman?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.50)
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

**JULIANA (Unwavering):**
Start: (00:49.20) | End: (00:52.40)
"A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:54.40)
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

**CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged):**
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:54.20)
"You are lying!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.40) | End: (00:58.00)
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

**JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic):**
Start: (00:54.60) | End: (00:58.00)
"Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.00) | End: (01:00.80)
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

**JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing):**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:01.00)
"He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.50)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

**JULIANA (Passionate, Clear):**
Start: (01:01.10) | End: (01:06.80)
"He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:07.00)
Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:09.00)
Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.

**JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious):**
Start: (01:07.20) | End: (01:08.90)
"Let him have Clarissa."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:09.00) | End: (01:11.20)
Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.

**JULIANA (Proud):**
Start: (01:09.60) | End: (01:11.20)
"He lost me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:13.30)
Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

**CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious):**
Start: (01:11.30) | End: (01:13.20)
"You were rejected!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.30) | End: (01:15.50)
Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

**JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful):**
Start: (01:13.40) | End: (01:17.60)
"I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:15.50) | End: (01:17.50)
Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:17.50) | End: (01:20.00)
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

**CATHERINE (Disdainful):**
Start: (01:17.80) | End: (01:19.40)
"Your soldier?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:20.00) | End: (01:22.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.

**JULIANA (Tender, Certain):**
Start: (01:20.20) | End: (01:22.00)
"My husband."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.10)
Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.

**CATHERINE (Bitter):**
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.00)
"He is a nobody."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.10) | End: (01:26.50)
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.

**JULIANA (Warm, Defiant):**
Start: (01:24.20) | End: (01:26.20)
"Then I love a nobody."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:29.80)
Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

**JULIANA (Resonant, Moving):**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:30.20)
"Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:29.80) | End: (01:32.80)
Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

**CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp):**
Start: (01:30.10) | End: (01:32.60)
"You know nothing about my world."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:32.80) | End: (01:37.00)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.

**JULIANA (Knowing, Sober):**
Start: (01:33.20) | End: (01:36.60)
"I know exactly what your world values."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:37.00) | End: (01:39.80)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.

**JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate):**
Start: (01:37.60) | End: (01:39.60)
"Beauty. Money."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.80) | End: (01:41.00)
Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:41.00) | End: (01:43.70)
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

**JULIANA (Firm):**
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:43.50)
"Family. A perfect name."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:43.70) | End: (01:47.00)
Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

**JULIANA (Continuing):**
Start: (01:43.80) | End: (01:47.20)
"And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:47.00) | End: (01:48.80)
Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.

**CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged):**
Start: (01:47.20) | End: (01:48.80)
"And what is wrong with that?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:49.40)
Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:49.40) | End: (01:52.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking serene.

**JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating):**
Start: (01:49.50) | End: (01:52.80)
"Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:52.50) | End: (01:56.00)
Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

**JULIANA (Unrelenting):**
Start: (01:52.80) | End: (01:56.00)
"You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:56.00) | End: (01:56.80)
Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:56.80) | End: (01:59.50)
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.

**JULIANA (Piercing):**
Start: (01:56.90) | End: (01:59.50)
"...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:59.50) | End: (02:01.80)
Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.

**CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming):**
Start: (01:59.60) | End: (02:01.80)
"Silence! Silence!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:01.80) | End: (02:03.00)
Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

**CATHERINE (Shrieking):**
Start: (02:01.80) | End: (02:02.80)
"Why?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:02.80) | End: (02:05.00)
Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

**JULIANA (Forceful):**
Start: (02:03.00) | End: (02:05.20)
"Because I am right!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:05.00) | End: (02:08.50)
Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

**JULIANA (Scathing, Direct):**
Start: (02:05.40) | End: (02:08.80)
"You want everyone to believe you are powerful."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:08.50) | End: (02:11.80)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

**JULIANA (Continuing):**
Start: (02:09.00) | End: (02:11.60)
"You want everyone to fear you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:11.80) | End: (02:14.80)
Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

**JULIANA (Mocking, Direct):**
Start: (02:12.00) | End: (02:14.00)
"But look at you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:14.80) | End: (02:18.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

**JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare):**
Start: (02:15.00) | End: (02:18.60)
"You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:18.50) | End: (02:20.40)
Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

**CATHERINE (Choking with Rage):**
Start: (02:18.60) | End: (02:20.20)
"You insolent—!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:20.40) | End: (02:22.40)
Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

**JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant):**
Start: (02:20.40) | End: (02:22.30)
"You may have the title you have always wanted..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:22.40) | End: (02:26.50)
Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.

**JULIANA (Final, Condemning):**
Start: (02:22.40) | End: (02:26.50)
"...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:26.50) | End: (02:28.00)
Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.

**CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting):**
Start: (02:26.60) | End: (02:28.10)
"You think you can lecture me?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:28.00) | End: (02:30.80)
Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:28.00) | End: (02:30.80)
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

**CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal):**
Start: (02:28.10) | End: (02:31.20)
"Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:30.80) | End: (02:32.00)
Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:31.20) | End: (02:34.38)
Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:32.00) | End: (02:34.38)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---
