logline: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
continuity_notes: Following Catherine's dungeon interrogation of Juliana, the conspiracy against Juliana deepens as an aristocratic lord forces a testimony of witchcraft out of the young maid whose brother Juliana saved.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. STUDY – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. STUDY – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:54.04

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.20)
Wide shot of a dimly lit, wood-paneled library study. An aristocratic lord in formal dark attire stands facing a young maid standing nervously by the open door.

**LORD (Cold, Authoritative):**
Start: (00:02.50) | End: (00:04.80)
"Your brother is breathing again."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:04.00) | End: (00:06.50)
The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.20) | End: (00:08.80)
Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.

**MAID (Meek, Hesitant):**
Start: (00:06.50) | End: (00:08.50)
"Yes, my Lord."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.80) | End: (00:12.00)
Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.

**LORD (Probing):**
Start: (00:09.50) | End: (00:11.80)
"And who saved him?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.00) | End: (00:14.80)
Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.

**MAID (Quiet, Truthful):**
Start: (00:13.00) | End: (00:14.50)
"Lady Juliana."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:14.80) | End: (00:17.80)
Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.

**LORD (Measured, Demanding):**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:17.50)
"Tell me how."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.80) | End: (00:21.00)
Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.

**MAID (Faltering):**
Start: (00:19.50) | End: (00:21.00)
"She... she used herbs."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.00) | End: (00:23.00)
Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.

**LORD (Sharp, Intimidating):**
Start: (00:21.20) | End: (00:22.80)
"What herbs?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.00) | End: (00:26.50)
Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.

**MAID (Whispering, Nervous):**
Start: (00:24.50) | End: (00:26.20)
"I don't know."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:29.20)
Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.

**LORD (Stern):**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:29.00)
"You watched her."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.20) | End: (00:32.80)
Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.

**MAID (Tearful, Sincere):**
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.00)
"I watched her save him."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:36.50)
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.

**LORD (Coldly Dismissive):**
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:36.20)
"That is not what I asked."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.50) | End: (00:40.20)
Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.

**LORD (Accusatory):**
Start: (00:37.50) | End: (00:40.00)
"Did she use her mother's book?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:40.20) | End: (00:44.20)
Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.

**MAID (Quietly Weeping):**
Start: (00:42.20) | End: (00:43.60)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:44.20) | End: (00:49.20)
Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.

**LORD (Insistent, Cornering):**
Start: (00:44.80) | End: (00:48.80)
"Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.20) | End: (00:52.50)
Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.

**MAID (Choked Sob):**
Start: (00:50.00) | End: (00:51.60)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:56.80)
Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.

**LORD (Sly, Sinister):**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:56.50)
"And did she perform anything unusual?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:59.00)
Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.

**MAID (Desperate, Denying):**
Start: (00:57.40) | End: (00:58.80)
"No!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.00) | End: (01:04.20)
Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.

**LORD (Low, Menacing):**
Start: (00:59.00) | End: (01:01.00)
"Think carefully."

**LORD (Ruthless):**
Start: (01:01.20) | End: (01:03.50)
"Your brother is still a pauper."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.20) | End: (01:08.80)
Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.

**LORD (Threatening):**
Start: (01:04.40) | End: (01:08.50)
"One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:08.50) | End: (01:10.00)
The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:08.80) | End: (01:13.20)
Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

**MAID (Begging, Heartbroken):**
Start: (01:09.50) | End: (01:13.00)
"Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.20) | End: (01:15.50)
Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

**LORD (Cold, Unwavering):**
Start: (01:13.20) | End: (01:15.00)
"Then help him."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:15.50) | End: (01:19.50)
Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

**MAID (Crying, Shattered):**
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:19.00)
"What do you want me to say?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:19.50) | End: (01:24.80)
Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

**LORD (Deceptive):**
Start: (01:19.60) | End: (01:20.50)
"The truth."

**LORD (Leading, Deliberate):**
Start: (01:21.00) | End: (01:24.50)
"She drew something around the bed, did she not?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.80) | End: (01:29.00)
Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

**MAID (Trembling, Reluctant):**
Start: (01:25.50) | End: (01:28.80)
"She... placed dried herbs around him."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:29.00) | End: (01:34.80)
Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

**LORD (Hypnotic, Coercive):**
Start: (01:29.00) | End: (01:30.50)
"Around him."

**LORD (Coercive):**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:32.50)
"Like a circle?"

**MAID (Faint, Defeated):**
Start: (01:33.00) | End: (01:34.50)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:34.80) | End: (01:38.50)
Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

**LORD (Whispering, Trap Snapping):**
Start: (01:35.00) | End: (01:38.00)
"And she opened her mother's book..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:38.50) | End: (01:40.80)
Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

**MAID (Sobbing):**
Start: (01:38.50) | End: (01:40.00)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:40.80) | End: (01:44.20)
Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

**LORD (Sinister):**
Start: (01:41.00) | End: (01:44.00)
"...and spoke words you could not understand."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:44.20) | End: (01:47.50)
Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

**MAID (Desperately Defending):**
Start: (01:44.50) | End: (01:46.50)
"She was praying!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:47.50) | End: (01:51.80)
Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

**LORD (Taunting):**
Start: (01:48.00) | End: (01:51.50)
"Praying... or chanting?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:51.80) | End: (01:53.80)
Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.

**MAID (Hysterically Sobbing):**
Start: (01:52.00) | End: (01:53.50)
"I don't know!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:53.80) | End: (01:59.50)
Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.

**LORD (Calculating, Relentless):**
Start: (01:54.00) | End: (01:56.50)
"You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs."

**LORD (Relentless):**
Start: (01:56.80) | End: (01:59.50)
"You saw her use a forbidden book."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:59.50) | End: (02:03.50)
Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.

**LORD (Condemning):**
Start: (01:59.80) | End: (02:02.80)
"You heard words you could not understand."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:03.50) | End: (02:06.80)
Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.

**LORD (Deadly, Resolute):**
Start: (02:04.50) | End: (02:06.50)
"That is witchcraft."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:06.80) | End: (02:11.80)
Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.

**MAID (Crying Out, Desperate):**
Start: (02:06.80) | End: (02:11.50)
"No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:11.80) | End: (02:14.50)
Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.

**LORD (Cold, Final):**
Start: (02:12.00) | End: (02:14.00)
"That will be your testimony."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:17.80)
Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.

**MAID (Gasping, Shocked):**
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:17.00)
"My testimony?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:17.80) | End: (02:20.50)
Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.

**LORD (Unyielding):**
Start: (02:18.00) | End: (02:20.00)
"Before the magistrate."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:24.80)
Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

**MAID (Wailing, Tormented):**
Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:24.00)
"I never said she was a witch!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:24.80) | End: (02:29.20)
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

**LORD (Chillingly Detached):**
Start: (02:25.00) | End: (02:26.50)
"You do not need to."

**LORD (Chillingly Detached):**
Start: (02:26.80) | End: (02:29.00)
"I have already written the story for you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:29.20) | End: (02:32.20)
Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.

**MAID (Sobbing):**
Start: (02:29.50) | End: (02:32.00)
"She saved my brother..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:32.20) | End: (02:36.20)
Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.

**LORD (Inexorable):**
Start: (02:32.50) | End: (02:36.00)
"And now... you will save your brother."

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:36.20) | End: (02:39.50)
The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:36.20) | End: (02:39.50)
High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.

**MAID (Weeping, Broken):**
Start: (02:39.00) | End: (02:41.50)
"I am sorry, Lady Juliana..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:39.50) | End: (02:43.80)
Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.

**LORD (Cold, Merciless):**
Start: (02:41.80) | End: (02:44.50)
"Save your tears for the trial."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:43.80) | End: (02:54.04)
Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:44.50) | End: (02:54.04)
The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.
continuity_notes: Following the aristocratic Lord's ruthless extortion of the young maid in his study, Episode 34 transitions directly into the crowded courtroom trial where the conspirators unleash their manufactured charges and false witnesses against Lady Juliana.

SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. COURTROOM – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 03:10.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.80)
High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.

**JUDGE (Booming, Authoritative):**
Start: (00:01.20) | End: (00:07.80)
"Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:02.80) | End: (00:07.80)
Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.80) | End: (00:13.10)
Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:09.00) | End: (00:11.20)
[A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]

**JUDGE (O.S.) (Inquisitive, Severe):**
Start: (00:09.10) | End: (00:12.60)
"Do you deny possessing this book?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.10) | End: (00:15.50)
Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.

**LADY JULIANA (Calm, Unflinching):**
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:14.80)
"No."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:19.40)
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.

**JUDGE (Stern, Accusatory):**
Start: (00:15.60) | End: (00:19.20)
"Do you deny using its remedies?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.40) | End: (00:23.80)
Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.

**LADY JULIANA (Firm):**
Start: (00:20.80) | End: (00:21.80)
"No."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.80) | End: (00:27.40)
Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:27.40) | End: (00:31.70)
Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.

**JUDGE (Hard, Pressing):**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:31.20)
"Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.70) | End: (00:35.30)
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.

**LADY JULIANA (Proud, Dignified):**
Start: (00:33.20) | End: (00:35.10)
"I admit to healing the sick."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:35.30) | End: (00:37.40)
The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.

**JUDGE (Furious, Shouting):**
Start: (00:35.40) | End: (00:36.60)
"Silence!"

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:37.00)
[Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:37.40)
Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.40) | End: (00:42.50)
Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.

**JUDGE (Commanding):**
Start: (00:37.50) | End: (00:41.20)
"Prudence. You served beside the accused?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:43.00)
Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.50) | End: (00:44.80)
Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.

**PRUDENCE (Trembling, Tearful):**
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:44.60)
"Yes, Your Honor."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:44.80) | End: (00:49.00)
Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.

**JUDGE (Probing, Formal):**
Start: (00:45.30) | End: (00:48.80)
"Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:51.50)
Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.

**LADY JULIANA (Softly, Urgent):**
Start: (00:49.10) | End: (00:50.50)
"Tell the truth."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:54.80)
Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.

**PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Heartbroken):**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:54.20)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:57.60)
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:57.60) | End: (01:00.80)
Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.

**JUDGE (Measured, Stern):**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:00.10)
"What did you see?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.60)
Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.

**PRUDENCE (Choked with Tears):**
Start: (01:01.30) | End: (01:04.40)
"She used herbs... and her mother's book."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.60) | End: (01:06.80)
Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.

**JUDGE (Pressing, Sharp):**
Start: (01:04.80) | End: (01:06.70)
"Did she draw strange markings?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:11.80)
Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.

**PRUDENCE (Faltering, Desperate):**
Start: (01:08.20) | End: (01:11.70)
"She... placed herbs around my brother's bed."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.80) | End: (01:15.80)
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.

**JUDGE (Accusatory, Forceful):**
Start: (01:12.10) | End: (01:15.50)
"And did she speak words you could not understand?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:15.80) | End: (01:21.00)
Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.

**PRUDENCE (Weeping, Shaken):**
Start: (01:18.80) | End: (01:20.50)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.00) | End: (01:25.20)
Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.

**LORD (Triumphant, Smug):**
Start: (01:21.30) | End: (01:24.90)
"Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:25.00) | End: (01:27.20)
Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:25.20) | End: (01:27.40)
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

**LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Indignant):**
Start: (01:25.20) | End: (01:27.20)
"It was not a ritual!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:27.20) | End: (01:30.20)
The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:27.40) | End: (01:30.50)
Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:27.80) | End: (01:29.20)
[Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

**JUDGE (Bellowing):**
Start: (01:27.90) | End: (01:30.00)
"You will speak when addressed!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:30.50) | End: (01:33.80)
Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.

**LORD (Calm, Poisonous):**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:33.20)
"We have further witnesses."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:33.80) | End: (01:38.20)
Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.

**TOWNSMAN (Nervous, Fearful):**
Start: (01:34.20) | End: (01:38.00)
"My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:38.20) | End: (01:39.50)
Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.

**JUDGE (Sharp):**
Start: (01:38.30) | End: (01:39.10)
"And?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.50) | End: (01:42.10)
Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.

**TOWNSMAN (Agitated):**
Start: (01:39.80) | End: (01:41.80)
"She became violently ill."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:42.10) | End: (01:47.30)
Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.

**OLD WOMAN (Shrill, Accusatory):**
Start: (01:42.30) | End: (01:47.00)
"My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:47.30) | End: (01:50.00)
Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.

**LORD (Mocking, Smug):**
Start: (01:48.00) | End: (01:49.80)
"She calls it healing."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:50.00) | End: (01:52.80)
The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:50.00) | End: (01:52.80)
Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.

**LORD (Resonant, Vindicative):**
Start: (01:50.10) | End: (01:52.60)
"The people call it poisoning!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:52.80) | End: (01:55.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.

**LADY JULIANA (Incisive, Defiant):**
Start: (01:53.20) | End: (01:55.00)
"What were their illnesses?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:55.20) | End: (01:57.20)
Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.

**LORD (Dismissive):**
Start: (01:55.30) | End: (01:56.50)
"Irrelevant."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:57.20) | End: (01:59.80)
Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

**LADY JULIANA (Fierce):**
Start: (01:57.40) | End: (01:59.60)
"It is not irrelevant!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:59.80) | End: (02:03.40)
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

**LADY JULIANA (Clear, Unyielding):**
Start: (01:59.90) | End: (02:03.20)
"Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:03.40) | End: (02:06.80)
Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.

**JUDGE (Coldly Inquisitive):**
Start: (02:03.60) | End: (02:06.40)
"You admit you administered them?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:06.80) | End: (02:09.10)
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.

**LADY JULIANA (Direct):**
Start: (02:07.20) | End: (02:08.20)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:09.10) | End: (02:11.80)
Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.

**JUDGE (Challenging):**
Start: (02:09.30) | End: (02:11.60)
"Without the approval of a licensed physician?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:11.80) | End: (02:14.60)
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.

**LADY JULIANA (Steely, Earnest):**
Start: (02:12.10) | End: (02:14.40)
"There was no physician willing to help them."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:14.60) | End: (02:19.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.

**LADY JULIANA (Calm, Resolute):**
Start: (02:16.20) | End: (02:18.40)
"So I helped them."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:19.20) | End: (02:22.20)
Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.

**LORD (Derisive):**
Start: (02:19.60) | End: (02:22.00)
"Even now, she refuses to repent."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:22.20) | End: (02:27.40)
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.

**JUDGE (Grave, Stern):**
Start: (02:22.40) | End: (02:27.00)
"Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:27.40) | End: (02:28.90)
Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:28.90) | End: (02:31.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

**LADY JULIANA (Unyielding):**
Start: (02:29.80) | End: (02:30.80)
"No."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:31.20) | End: (02:34.80)
Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

**JUDGE (Ominous, Warning):**
Start: (02:31.80) | End: (02:33.80)
"Think carefully."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:34.80) | End: (02:36.80)
Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

**LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute):**
Start: (02:35.20) | End: (02:36.40)
"I have."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:36.80) | End: (02:42.00)
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

**JUDGE (Severe, Imposing):**
Start: (02:37.00) | End: (02:41.80)
"You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:42.00) | End: (02:43.60)
Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

**LADY JULIANA (Proud, Fearless):**
Start: (02:42.10) | End: (02:43.50)
"Then let it be."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:43.60) | End: (02:46.80)
Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:44.00) | End: (02:46.80)
Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:46.80) | End: (02:54.40)
Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.

**LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant):**
Start: (02:47.00) | End: (02:53.60)
"Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:54.40) | End: (02:56.50)
Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:56.50) | End: (02:58.20)
The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:56.50) | End: (02:58.20)
Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (02:56.60) | End: (02:57.60)
[Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]

**JUDGE (Thunderous):**
Start: (02:57.80) | End: (02:59.40)
"Enough!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:59.50) | End: (03:04.50)
The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:59.50) | End: (03:04.50)
Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.

**JUDGE (Booming, Solemn):**
Start: (03:01.00) | End: (03:04.20)
"Lady Juliana Ashcroft..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (03:04.50) | End: (03:10.00)
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.

**ACTION:**
Start: (03:05.00) | End: (03:10.00)
The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

logline: Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.
continuity_notes: While Juliana faces trial and sentencing in the courtroom, this episode reveals Alexander's mother escaping confinement and tracking down Alexander in his mountain hideout, uncovering the dark treason that orchestrates both their fates.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. STONE CORRIDOR - NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. STONE CORRIDOR - NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:15.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.20)
Medium tracking shot following an elderly hooded woman clutching an iron lantern as she stumbles anxiously through a damp subterranean stone tunnel.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.20)
Alexander's mother, frail with silver hair under a dark hooded cloak, braces her hand against the rough stone wall, panting heavily in fear.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Determined, Breathless):**
Start: (00:05.50) | End: (00:08.50)
"I will not die in that house."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.00) | End: (00:12.80)
Close-up on her trembling, weathered hands gripping a mossy stone bolt set into a heavy iron plate on the stone wall.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:09.50) | End: (00:12.80)
She uses all her strength to shove the stone bolt upward, disengaging the hidden lock mechanism.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:11.20) | End: (00:13.00)
Heavy stone grating and metallic latch clanging as the lock releases.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:13.00) | End: (00:15.50)
The heavy stone doorway swings inward, and the elderly woman ducks low, crawling through the opening into the cold night outside.

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: EXT. SNOWY FOREST / CABIN - NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: EXT. SNOWY FOREST / CABIN - NIGHT
Scene start: 00:15.50
Scene end: 00:27.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:19.50)
Wide atmospheric shot of a deep, snow-covered pine forest at night. In the distance stands a small secluded log cabin nestled under towering snowy trees.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:19.50)
Alexander's mother plods through the thick snow, leaning heavily on a wooden walking stick, her dark cloak dusted with snow.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:16.00) | End: (00:19.50)
Howling winter wind and crunching of footsteps in deep snow.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.50) | End: (00:24.00)
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother arriving beside the frosted wooden door frame under sharp hanging icicles, shivering violently from the freezing cold.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Whispering, Weary):**
Start: (00:21.00) | End: (00:23.00)
"This must be the place."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:24.00) | End: (00:27.50)
Close-up on her wool-gloved hand unlatching the icy wooden door handle and pushing it open.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:24.80) | End: (00:27.00)
Creak of cold wooden hinges opening.

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: INT. SECLUDED CABIN - CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: INT. SECLUDED CABIN - CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:27.50
Scene end: 02:37.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:30.80)
Panning shot from the open doorway revealing the warm, dimly lit cabin interior, settling on Alexander standing over a rustic wooden table by lantern light.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:28.50) | End: (00:30.80)
Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:33.80)
Medium shot of Alexander's mother stepping across the threshold, holding up her burning lantern, her eyes wide with shock.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.80) | End: (00:36.50)
Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.50) | End: (00:40.50)
Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing, Stunned):**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:40.00)
"Alexander!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:40.50) | End: (00:44.20)
Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.

**ALEXANDER (Breathless, In Disbelief):**
Start: (00:42.50) | End: (00:44.20)
"Mother?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:44.20) | End: (00:47.50)
She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping, Overwhelmed):**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:48.00)
"You're alive."

**ALEXANDER (Gentle, Choked Up):**
Start: (00:48.00) | End: (00:49.80)
"Mother."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:50.00) | End: (00:55.50)
She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Heartbroken):**
Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:55.00)
"I buried you."

**ALEXANDER (Soft, Somber):**
Start: (00:56.50) | End: (00:58.00)
"I know."

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Anguished, Accusing):**
Start: (00:59.50) | End: (01:06.00)
"They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.50) | End: (01:11.00)
Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.

**ALEXANDER (Dark, Resigned):**
Start: (01:08.50) | End: (01:10.80)
"Most of them were."

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Searching, Desperate):**
Start: (01:11.50) | End: (01:14.00)
"Then how did you survive?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.20) | End: (01:18.00)
Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

**ALEXANDER (Grim, Quiet):**
Start: (01:15.00) | End: (01:17.50)
"I wasn't supposed to."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:18.00) | End: (01:22.50)
Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

**ALEXANDER (Solemn):**
Start: (01:19.00) | End: (01:23.00)
"Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:23.00) | End: (01:27.00)
Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

**ALEXANDER (Steady, Focused):**
Start: (01:23.00) | End: (01:29.00)
"It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:27.00) | End: (01:29.80)
Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:29.80) | End: (01:32.00)
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shocked):**
Start: (01:29.80) | End: (01:31.50)
"A traitor?"

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Firm):**
Start: (01:32.00) | End: (01:33.20)
"Yes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:33.50) | End: (01:37.50)
Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

**ALEXANDER (Grave):**
Start: (01:34.50) | End: (01:37.00)
"We were close to finding him."

**ALEXANDER (Hardened):**
Start: (01:38.50) | End: (01:41.00)
"Then came the ambush."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:44.20)
Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

**ALEXANDER (Bitter, Painful):**
Start: (01:41.50) | End: (01:44.20)
"My men were slaughtered."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:44.20) | End: (01:46.50)
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious):**
Start: (01:44.50) | End: (01:46.00)
"And you?"

**ALEXANDER (Hollow):**
Start: (01:47.00) | End: (01:50.00)
"I was shot. Left for dead."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:50.00) | End: (01:53.50)
Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Astonished):**
Start: (01:51.00) | End: (01:53.00)
"How did you escape?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:53.50) | End: (01:58.00)
Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

**ALEXANDER (Somber, Low):**
Start: (01:54.00) | End: (01:58.00)
"I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone."

**ALEXANDER (Continuing):**
Start: (01:58.20) | End: (02:02.00)
"I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:02.00) | End: (02:05.50)
Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned):**
Start: (02:02.00) | End: (02:05.50)
"Then why did they never tell us?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:05.50) | End: (02:09.50)
Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

**ALEXANDER (Ominous, Deliberate):**
Start: (02:06.00) | End: (02:09.50)
"Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Breathless):**
Start: (02:09.50) | End: (02:10.50)
"Who?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:10.50) | End: (02:14.00)
Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.

**ALEXANDER (Brooding):**
Start: (02:11.00) | End: (02:14.00)
"I spent three years trying to find out."

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:14.00) | End: (02:16.80)
Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.

**ALEXANDER (Fierce, Resolute):**
Start: (02:14.00) | End: (02:17.00)
"The ambush was not an accident."

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:17.00) | End: (02:24.00)
He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.

**ALEXANDER (Vehement, Enraged):**
Start: (02:17.00) | End: (02:20.50)
"Someone ordered my men to die."

**ALEXANDER (Darkly Intimating):**
Start: (02:21.00) | End: (02:24.00)
"Someone wanted me erased."

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Terrified):**
Start: (02:24.00) | End: (02:25.00)
"Who?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:25.00) | End: (02:30.50)
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.

**ALEXANDER (Deadly, Chilling):**
Start: (02:25.50) | End: (02:30.00)
"The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:30.50) | End: (02:37.50)
Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (02:30.80) | End: (02:37.50)
A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

--- SCRIPT END ---

timeline_events.text: Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Solemn)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Steady, Focused)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shocked)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
timeline_events.text: "A traitor?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Firm)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Yes."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Grave)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "We were close to finding him."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Hardened)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Then came the ambush."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Bitter, Painful)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "My men were slaughtered."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
timeline_events.text: "And you?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Hollow)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "I was shot. Left for dead."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Astonished)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
timeline_events.text: "How did you escape?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Somber, Low)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Continuing)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
timeline_events.text: "Then why did they never tell us?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Ominous, Deliberate)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Breathless)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
timeline_events.text: "Who?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Brooding)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "I spent three years trying to find out."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Resolute)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "The ambush was not an accident."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Vehement, Enraged)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Someone ordered my men to die."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Darkly Intimating)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Someone wanted me erased."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Terrified)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
timeline_events.text: "Who?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Chilling)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-035-Episode 1681368.txt

timeline_events.text: A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

logline: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
continuity_notes: Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. SECLUDED CABIN – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. SECLUDED CABIN – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 03:20.75

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.20)
Medium two-shot across the weathered wooden table lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, framing Alexander and his mother leaning inward in the dimly lit cabin.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.80)
Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Whispering, Distraught):**
Start: (00:00.80) | End: (00:03.70)
"Then why did they never find you?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.20) | End: (00:08.50)
Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Bitter):**
Start: (00:04.80) | End: (00:08.20)
"Because they made certain no one would look."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:12.80)
Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling):**
Start: (00:09.50) | End: (00:11.20)
"Who?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.80) | End: (00:17.50)
Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.

**ALEXANDER (Grave, Sinister):**
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:17.00)
"Sterling... and Rupert."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.50) | End: (00:20.80)
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Stricken):**
Start: (00:17.60) | End: (00:19.80)
"Rupert?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.80) | End: (00:23.60)
Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.

**ALEXANDER (Stern, Resolute):**
Start: (00:21.00) | End: (00:23.50)
"They knew where I was."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.60) | End: (00:29.00)
Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

**ALEXANDER (Fierce):**
Start: (00:23.70) | End: (00:28.80)
"My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.00) | End: (00:31.90)
Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Horrified):**
Start: (00:29.20) | End: (00:31.70)
"They gave you to the enemy?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.90) | End: (00:35.80)
Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.

**ALEXANDER (Deadpan, Resolute):**
Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:34.50)
"They gave them my location."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:38.90)
Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.

**ALEXANDER (Spitting with Contempt):**
Start: (00:36.20) | End: (00:38.70)
"They wanted the investigation buried."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:38.90) | End: (00:41.50)
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shattered):**
Start: (00:39.10) | End: (00:41.40)
"And when you disappeared...?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:41.50) | End: (00:44.80)
Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

**ALEXANDER (Cold):**
Start: (00:41.60) | End: (00:43.70)
"They declared me dead."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:44.80) | End: (00:48.80)
Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

**ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Grave):**
Start: (00:45.30) | End: (00:48.50)
"They falsified what remained of the reports."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:45.30) | End: (00:48.80)
Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.80) | End: (00:52.00)
Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Bitter):**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:51.80)
"And Rupert took Ashbourne."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.00) | End: (00:55.50)
Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.

**ALEXANDER (Darkly):**
Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:55.30)
"While the world mourned a dead heir."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.50) | End: (00:58.80)
Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears):**
Start: (00:56.00) | End: (00:58.50)
"And I mourned you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.80) | End: (01:00.80)
Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.

**ALEXANDER (Softly):**
Start: (00:59.20) | End: (01:00.40)
"I know."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.20)
Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing):**
Start: (01:00.90) | End: (01:03.80)
"I trusted them."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.20) | End: (01:07.50)
Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.

**ALEXANDER (Gentle yet Firm):**
Start: (01:05.10) | End: (01:07.30)
"You trusted family."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:11.00)
Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.

**ALEXANDER (Resentful):**
Start: (01:07.80) | End: (01:10.50)
"They used that trust against you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.00) | End: (01:14.80)
Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.

**ALEXANDER (Urgent, Anxious):**
Start: (01:12.10) | End: (01:14.70)
"Mother... Juliana..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:18.20)
Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.

**ALEXANDER (Intense):**
Start: (01:14.90) | End: (01:18.10)
"She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.20) | End: (01:21.80)
Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.

**ALEXANDER (Tremulous):**
Start: (01:18.80) | End: (01:21.70)
"I thought perhaps she stayed with you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.80) | End: (01:24.00)
Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Hesitant, Trembling):**
Start: (01:22.00) | End: (01:23.80)
"Alexander..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.00) | End: (01:26.50)
Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.

**ALEXANDER (Alarmed):**
Start: (01:24.40) | End: (01:25.50)
"What?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:30.00)
Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked):**
Start: (01:27.20) | End: (01:29.80)
"She did come to me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:30.00) | End: (01:33.20)
Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.

**ALEXANDER (Demanding):**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:33.10)
"Is she still at Ashbourne?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:33.20) | End: (01:36.50)
Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing):**
Start: (01:33.50) | End: (01:35.80)
"No..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:39.00)
Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

**ALEXANDER (Desperate):**
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:38.50)
"Then where is she?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.00) | End: (01:43.50)
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Wailing):**
Start: (01:39.50) | End: (01:43.20)
"They arrested her!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:43.50) | End: (01:45.80)
Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

**ALEXANDER (Stunned):**
Start: (01:44.00) | End: (01:45.50)
"Arrested?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:45.80) | End: (01:50.00)
Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Despairing):**
Start: (01:45.90) | End: (01:49.80)
"Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:50.00) | End: (01:54.00)
Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

**ALEXANDER (Shouting, Incredulous):**
Start: (01:51.80) | End: (01:53.80)
"But she saved you!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:54.00) | End: (01:57.00)
Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping):**
Start: (01:54.20) | End: (01:56.50)
"I told them!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:57.00) | End: (01:59.50)
Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

**ALEXANDER (Furious):**
Start: (01:57.50) | End: (01:59.30)
"You told them the truth!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:59.50) | End: (02:03.00)
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Agonized):**
Start: (01:59.80) | End: (02:02.50)
"They called her a witch!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:03.00) | End: (02:07.50)
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

**ALEXANDER (Horrified):**
Start: (02:03.80) | End: (02:06.80)
"Juliana... is in a cell?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:07.50) | End: (02:10.80)
Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weak, Trembling):**
Start: (02:07.80) | End: (02:10.50)
"She was taken before a magistrate."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:10.80) | End: (02:12.00)
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

**ALEXANDER (Barking):**
Start: (02:10.90) | End: (02:11.80)
"And?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:12.00) | End: (02:15.00)
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping):**
Start: (02:12.20) | End: (02:14.40)
"They condemned her."

**ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Gasping):**
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:15.20)

logline: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.
continuity_notes: Following Alexander's vow to return in two days to disrupt the wedding, Rupert and Catherine prepare to cement their coup by inviting high society to celebrate their nuptials and witness Juliana's execution.

scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. ASHBRIDGE MANOR - GRAND CORRIDOR – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:34.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.50)
Low-angle shot tilting down to a polished mahogany table as a white-gloved servant places a tall stack of wax-sealed wedding invitations onto a silver tray.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:01.50) | End: (00:03.20)
The crisp tap of heavy cardstock envelopes being set down onto silver.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.50) | End: (00:09.50)
Medium two-shot framed symmetrically down the vaulted, sunlit hallway. Blond Nobleman Rupert stands tall in a black embroidered frock coat, facing Catherine in an ornate pink gown.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Cold, Calculating):**
Start: (00:06.00) | End: (00:09.30)
"Every important family in the county should witness it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.50) | End: (00:12.50)
Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.

**CATHERINE (Inquiring, Smug):**
Start: (00:10.80) | End: (00:12.40)
"The wedding?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.50) | End: (00:15.00)
Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Authoritative):**
Start: (00:12.80) | End: (00:14.80)
"The transfer of Ashbridge."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:18.80)
Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.

**CATHERINE (Gloating):**
Start: (00:15.60) | End: (00:18.80)
"After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:23.20)
Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Sinister, Ruthless):**
Start: (00:19.00) | End: (00:23.00)
"And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.20) | End: (00:26.50)
Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.

**CATHERINE (Venomous Satisfaction):**
Start: (00:23.80) | End: (00:26.40)
"Juliana's execution comes after the wedding."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:30.00)
Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.

**CATHERINE (Gleeful):**
Start: (00:26.60) | End: (00:29.80)
"Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.00) | End: (00:32.50)
Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Decisive):**
Start: (00:30.20) | End: (00:32.20)
"Send the invitations."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:32.50) | End: (00:34.50)
Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.

**CATHERINE (Spiteful):**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:34.50)
"Especially to the Ashcrofts."

SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. NOBLE MANOR - PARLOR – DAY
Scene start: 00:34.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.50) | End: (00:37.00)
Wide tracking shot down a palatial marble hall as a butler carries a silver tray toward double doors.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:39.80)
Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.

**BUTLER (Formal):**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:39.80)
"Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:39.50) | End: (00:44.00)
Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:44.00) | End: (00:46.80)
Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.

**LADY CLARISSA (Amused, Thrilled):**
Start: (00:44.50) | End: (00:46.50)
"Catherine's wedding."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:49.50)
Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.

**NOBLEMAN (Observant):**
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:49.20)
"So it is finally official."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.50) | End: (00:53.00)
Close-up of Clarissa smiling down at the calligraphy.

**LADY CLARISSA (Mockingly Reverent):**
Start: (00:50.00) | End: (00:52.80)
"Lady Catherine Ashbridge."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:56.00)
Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.

**LADY CLARISSA (Intrigued):**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (00:56.20)
"And after the ceremony..."

**NOBLEMAN (Curious):**
Start: (00:56.20) | End: (00:57.20)
"What?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:58.50)
Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.

Medium close-up of the nobleman looking down pensively at the open execution clause on the table.

"That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly."

Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.

**LADY CLARISSA (Chilling Proclamation):**

"Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place."

**ACTION:**

Start: (02:27.50) | End: (02:36.47)

Start: (02:28.00) | End: (02:36.47)
A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.

logline: A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.
continuity_notes: Following Rupert and Catherine's cruel announcement pairing their wedding with Juliana's public execution, Juliana remains starved in the subterranean dungeon awaiting her fate.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. DUNGEON CELL – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. DUNGEON CELL – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:27.91

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.00)
Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.50)
Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:03.20) | End: (00:06.00)
Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.00) | End: (00:07.50)
Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:05.00) | End: (00:07.50)
Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.50) | End: (00:11.00)
Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:11.00)
The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.00) | End: (00:15.50)
Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:11.00) | End: (00:15.50)
The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:17.50)
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.

**JULIANA (Breathless, Bewildered):**
Start: (00:16.00) | End: (00:17.30)
"Why?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.50) | End: (00:21.50)
Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.

**GUARD (Subdued, Sincere):**
Start: (00:17.50) | End: (00:20.30)
"Because no one should die hungry."

**GUARD (Urgent, Whispered):**
Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:22.00)
"Eat it before they see."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.50) | End: (00:23.20)
Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:23.20)
The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.20) | End: (00:30.50)
Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:23.50) | End: (00:27.50)
Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.

**JULIANA (Choked Up, Tearful):**
Start: (00:26.00) | End: (00:27.50)
"Thank you."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:27.80) | End: (00:31.00)
Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:35.00)
Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:34.50)
Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.

**JULIANA (Sorrowful, Whispering):**
Start: (00:34.50) | End: (00:36.50)
"Alexander..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:39.50)
Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.

**JULIANA (Yearning):**
Start: (00:36.80) | End: (00:39.00)
"...are you safe?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:39.50) | End: (00:45.50)
Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.

**JULIANA (Desperate, Trembling):**
Start: (00:40.00) | End: (00:43.00)
"Do you even know what happened to me?"

**JULIANA (Grief-Stricken):**
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:45.20)
"Do you know they condemned me?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:51.00)
Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.

**JULIANA (Fearful, Pleading):**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:47.50)
"What if I die here?"

**JULIANA (Heartbroken):**
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:50.50)
"What if I never see you again?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:51.00)
A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:55.50)
Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.

**JULIANA (Fervent Prayer):**
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:53.50)
"Keep him safe."

**JULIANA (Resigned):**
Start: (00:53.80) | End: (00:55.30)
"Wherever he is."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.50) | End: (01:00.50)
Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.

**JULIANA (Determined):**
Start: (00:55.50) | End: (00:57.00)
"Let him live."

**JULIANA (Steely):**
Start: (00:57.50) | End: (01:00.50)
"And if I have only one thing left to give..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.50) | End: (01:04.00)
Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.

**JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable):**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:02.50)
"I will not give them my husband."

**JULIANA (Resolute):**
Start: (01:02.80) | End: (01:04.20)
"I will not betray him."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.00) | End: (01:07.00)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.50)
Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:04.80) | End: (01:27.00)
Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:10.50)
Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.

**JULIANA (Startled Whisper):**
Start: (01:09.00) | End: (01:10.30)
"Bells."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:12.50)
Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:11.00) | End: (01:13.50)
Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:12.50) | End: (01:18.50)
Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.

**JULIANA (Realizing):**
Start: (01:12.80) | End: (01:14.20)
"The wedding."

**JULIANA (Grim):**
Start: (01:14.50) | End: (01:15.80)
"It's beginning."

**JULIANA (Somber, Steely):**
Start: (01:16.00) | End: (01:18.50)
"Then I suppose I'm next."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.50) | End: (01:24.50)
Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:21.00) | End: (01:24.00)
Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.

**JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender):**
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.00)
"Alexander..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.50) | End: (01:27.91)
Dramatic cut to black.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:24.50) | End: (01:27.91)
A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

--- SCRIPT END ---

timeline_events.text: "Alexander..."

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Yearning)

timeline_events.text: "...are you safe?"

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Fervent Prayer)

timeline_events.text: "Keep him safe."

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Determined)

timeline_events.text: "Let him live."

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Steely)

timeline_events.text: "And if I have only one thing left to give..."

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable)

timeline_events.text: "I will not give them my husband."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-038-Episode 1681371.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Resolute)

timeline_events.text: "I will not betray him."

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Startled Whisper)

timeline_events.label: CAMERA

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Realizing)
