source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-039-Episode 1686799.txt
logline: While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up as the wedding bells toll for Rupert and Catherine's ceremony. While Juliana prepares for execution in the dungeon below, Alexander's coordinated strike to liberate the cathedral and reclaim his birthright begins.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: EXT. COBBLESTONE STREET - DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: EXT. COBBLESTONE STREET - DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:13.80

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.60)
Low-angle tracking shot from behind wagon wheels framing laborers unloading wooden crates from a horse-drawn cart in the bustling town square.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.60)
Men in work clothes stack wooden crates onto the back of a large carriage as horses snort restlessly in the morning mist.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.60) | End: (00:07.10)
Medium close-up profile shot of a vigilant scout in a dark brimmed hat holding reins and surveying the street.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:04.60) | End: (00:07.10)
The scout stands quietly by a wooden rail, keeping a sharp eye on passing civilians.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.10) | End: (00:09.60)
Artistic framing through the spokes of a large wooden wagon wheel looking out across the cobblestones toward church spires in the distance.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.60) | End: (00:13.80)
Close-up of a disguised loyalist adjusting his flat cap, followed by a low-angle tracking shot of two men walking briskly over the wet cobblestones.

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: EXT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE & ALLEY - CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: EXT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE & ALLEY - CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:13.80
Scene end: 00:24.20

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:15.80)
Wide symmetrical establishing shot of the grand Gothic cathedral entrance flanked by armed royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin hats standing on stone steps.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:15.80)
Four royal guards in red ceremonial tunics and tall black bearskin hats stand rigidly at attention with rifles on the grand cathedral staircase.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.80) | End: (00:18.00)
Medium shot in a nearby alleyway where two loyalist conspirators huddle beside bundles of hay, discreetly passing a folded message.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.00) | End: (00:22.40)
Close profile two-shot of the two loyalist soldiers watching the cathedral spires in the distance.

**LOYALIST SCOUT (Low, Urgent):**
Start: (00:18.30) | End: (00:19.90)
"Six at the front."

**LOYALIST FIGHTER (Grave):**
Start: (00:20.20) | End: (00:21.80)
"Four more inside."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.40) | End: (00:24.20)
Medium over-the-shoulder shot of the two men conferring as townsfolk pass in the foreground.

**LOYALIST SCOUT (Focused):**
Start: (00:22.50) | End: (00:23.20)
"And the east gate?"

**LOYALIST FIGHTER (Determined):**
Start: (00:23.30) | End: (00:24.20)
"Ours."

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: EXT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE - CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: EXT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE - CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:24.20
Scene end: 00:50.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:24.20) | End: (00:29.60)
Wide crane shot panning down as a horse-drawn cart loaded with cut firewood pulls up along the wet stone pavement in front of the cathedral steps.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:24.20) | End: (00:29.60)
A lone driver in rugged attire guides the horse cart slowly toward the sentries guarding the arched entryway.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.60) | End: (00:32.40)
Medium two-shot of the royal sentry stepping forward and extending a white-gloved hand to halt the cart.

**ROYAL SENTRY (Commanding):**
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:30.60)
"Stop!"

**CART DRIVER (Meek, Deferential):**
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:32.40)
"Firewood for the kitchens, sir."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:36.50)
Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:36.50)
The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:33.10) | End: (00:36.00)
Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.50) | End: (00:42.80)
Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:42.50)
The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.

**LOYALIST FIGHTER (Whispering, Cold):**
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:42.20)
"Sleep."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:46.80)
Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:50.00)
Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.

**CART DRIVER (Relieved, Firm):**
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:48.10)
"The road is clear."

**LOYALIST FIGHTER (Resolute):**
Start: (00:48.20) | End: (00:49.20)
"Tell the Duke."

SCENE 04

scenes.label: SCENE 04
scenes.heading: INT. WOODEN CABIN - DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 04
Scene heading: INT. WOODEN CABIN - DAY
Scene start: 00:50.00
Scene end: 01:08.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:50.00) | End: (00:52.80)
Close-up framed into a cracked wooden wall mirror reflecting Alexander with long unkempt hair, a thick beard, and combat scars across his cheek.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:50.00) | End: (00:52.80)
Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:55.80)
Tilt-down medium close-up over a wooden table displaying a pristine navy-and-gold embroidered ducal uniform, ornate lion crest brooch, white cravat, razor, and scissors.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.80) | End: (00:59.80)
Medium profile shot of Alexander lifting the metal shears beside the window light, raising them toward his hair.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:56.50) | End: (00:59.80)
Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:57.20) | End: (01:00.80)
Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.80) | End: (01:01.20)
Medium shot as Alexander trims his beard at the jawline.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:01.20) | End: (01:06.60)
Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:02.00) | End: (01:06.60)
Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.

**ALEXANDER (Deep, Steely Resolve):**
Start: (01:02.00) | End: (01:02.80)
"Enough hiding."

**ALEXANDER (Dark, Unforgiving):**
Start: (01:03.00) | End: (01:05.50)
"They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago."

**ALEXANDER (Fierce, Commanding):**
Start: (01:05.60) | End: (01:06.90)
"Today, he comes home."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.60) | End: (01:08.50)
Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.

SCENE 05

scenes.label: SCENE 05
scenes.heading: EXT. WOODEN OUTPOST / SNOWY PATH - DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 05
Scene heading: EXT. WOODEN OUTPOST / SNOWY PATH - DAY
Scene start: 01:08.50
Scene end: 01:38.41

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:08.50) | End: (01:11.80)
Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:08.50) | End: (01:11.80)
Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.80) | End: (01:14.80)
Extreme close-up of Alexander's hand adjusting the ornate golden lion crest pinned at his cravat.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:17.80)
Medium low-angle shot as a loyalist soldier drops down onto one knee before him in the snow.

**LOYALIST (Reverent, Submissive):**
Start: (01:15.80) | End: (01:17.20)
"Your Grace."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:17.80) | End: (01:22.50)
Close-up profile of Alexander, his breath pluming in the winter cold, his eyes hardened like steel.

**ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Command):**
Start: (01:20.50) | End: (01:22.20)
"Secure the chapel."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:25.20)
Medium close-up of the soldier rising and snapping a crisp military salute.

**LOYALIST (Resolute):**
Start: (01:23.80) | End: (01:25.20)
"Yes, Your Grace."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:25.20) | End: (01:35.00)
Slow dramatic tracking shot moving backward in front of Alexander as he strides purposefully through the deep snow, the wooden chapel looming in the distance behind him.

**ALEXANDER (Powerful, Roaring Defiance):**
Start: (01:25.50) | End: (01:27.20)
"No more hiding."

**ALEXANDER (Fierce, Unyielding):**
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:30.20)
"I am taking back my house."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:30.20) | End: (01:35.00)
Alexander marches forward unstoppably, his long coat fluttering in the winter wind as his icy gaze locks forward.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:35.00) | End: (01:38.41)
Dramatic push-in close-up directly onto Alexander's scarred, fierce face as he speaks with absolute conviction.

**ALEXANDER (Passionate, Unstoppable Vow):**
Start: (01:35.00) | End: (01:38.00)
"And I am bringing my wife home."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:37.80) | End: (01:38.41)
Alexander's eyes burn with furious determination as the screen cuts sharply to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: High society gathers at the grand cathedral for Rupert and Catherine's lavish wedding, while the conspirators ensure every exit is sealed to seal Juliana's execution—unaware that Alexander's retribution is already at their gates.
continuity_notes: Picks up right after Alexander commands his men to secure the chapel and vows to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana; inside the cathedral, the wedding guests arrive and the conspirators finalize their sinister plot.

scenes.heading: EXT. CATHEDRAL STEPS – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: EXT. CATHEDRAL STEPS – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:34.20

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.80)
Wide establishing shot looking up at the imposing stone Gothic cathedral as noble guests in formal Regency attire ascend the grand steps.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.80)
Somber cathedral bells tolling and the distant murmur of arriving carriages.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.80) | End: (00:08.50)
Medium wide shot of an ornate black and gold royal carriage pulling up to the cobblestone courtyard. A footman in white gloves steps forward and opens the carriage door.

**FOOTMAN (Formal, Resonant):**
Start: (00:05.50) | End: (00:07.40)
"The Harrington family."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:12.20)
Medium shot as Lord Harrington in a tailored black tailcoat and white waistcoat steps down from the carriage, turning to extend his gloved hand to Lady Harrington, who gracefully descends.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:10.00) | End: (00:12.40)
Lady Harrington takes his hand and steps onto the pavement, clutching a velvet reticule.

**LADY HARRINGTON (Smug, Impressed):**
Start: (00:12.40) | End: (00:17.30)
"Look at them. Every noble family in the county is here today."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.40) | End: (00:19.00)
Medium two-shot tracking slightly as Lord and Lady Harrington pause arm-in-arm, taking in the gathering crowd of high society.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.00) | End: (00:23.00)
Low-angle shot from behind as they ascend the stone steps toward the arched cathedral entrance.

**LORD HARRINGTON (Ambitious, Proud):**
Start: (00:19.20) | End: (00:23.00)
"And soon, we'll be connected to the Duchess of Ashburgh."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.00) | End: (00:26.20)
Tight close-up profile of Lady Harrington, her eyes glistening with cruel satisfaction in the soft sunlight.

**LADY HARRINGTON (Malicious, Taunting):**
Start: (00:23.20) | End: (00:26.00)
"Imagine Juliana seeing this."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.20) | End: (00:30.00)
Tight close-up of Lord Harrington looking down at her, his expression cold and ruthless.

**LORD HARRINGTON (Sinister, Dismissive):**
Start: (00:26.20) | End: (00:28.90)
"She won't be seeing anything for long."

**LADY HARRINGTON (Pleased, Cold):**
Start: (00:29.00) | End: (00:29.90)
"Good."

**LORD HARRINGTON (Chuckling, Scornful):**
Start: (00:30.10) | End: (00:33.20)
"This place has always been unlucky for Juliana."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:34.20)
Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.

SCENE 02

"We have an excellent view."

**LADY HARRINGTON (Chilling, Sarcastic):**

SCENE 03

**CAMERA:**

Medium shot of Rupert, the Blond Nobleman, standing before the altar draped in floral garlands. He wears an ornate silver-embroidered black formal coat and nervously adjusts his pristine white gloves.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Nervous, Determined):**
Start: (00:50.80) | End: (00:53.20)

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:53.20) | End: (00:55.80)
Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.

Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:03.80)
High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:03.80) | End: (01:09.50)
Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Scheming):**
Start: (01:05.00) | End: (01:06.80)
"All entrances are covered?"

**ROYAL GUARD (Obedient, Firm):**
Start: (01:06.90) | End: (01:08.20)
"Every one, my Lord."

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculating):**
Start: (01:08.30) | End: (01:09.30)
"Good."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:09.50) | End: (01:14.50)
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless, Victorious):**
Start: (01:09.80) | End: (01:14.20)
"By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.50) | End: (01:18.50)

**ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadly, Uncompromising):**
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:17.40)
"And its witch will be dead."

**CAMERA:**

Medium close-up of Lady Harrington leaning forward from her pew, utterly captivated.

**LADY HARRINGTON (Awestruck, Whispering):**

"She looks like a queen."

logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 40 where Rupert and Catherine met at the altar; Catherine halts the vows to stage a public humiliation of Juliana, unaware that Alexander's forces are already detonating the cathedral gates.

SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:36.09

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:01.80)
Wide symmetrical shot looking down the candlelit, flower-strewn aisle toward the altar where Rupert, Catherine, and the Priest stand.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:04.50)
Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.

**CATHERINE (Imperious, Commanding):**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:02.80)
"Wait."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:08.50)
Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.

**CATHERINE (Haughty, Loud):**
Start: (00:04.90) | End: (00:08.20)
"Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:13.00)
Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.

**CATHERINE (Cruel, Resonant):**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:12.70)
"...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.00) | End: (00:15.50)
Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Subdued, Inquiring):**
Start: (00:13.20) | End: (00:14.00)
"Catherine..."

**CATHERINE (Callous, Projecting):**
Start: (00:14.00) | End: (00:15.30)
"Bring her in."

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:17.50)
Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:20.00)
Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:17.50) | End: (00:20.00)
Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.00) | End: (00:22.80)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.80) | End: (00:26.00)
Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.00) | End: (00:28.80)
Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.

**CATHERINE (Smug, Taunting):**
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:28.40)
"There she is."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.80) | End: (00:30.00)
Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.00) | End: (00:34.00)
Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Gleeful, Whispering):**
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:31.60)
"Look at her."

**NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Chuckling):**
Start: (00:31.70) | End: (00:33.80)
"She actually came back to the chapel."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:36.80)
Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

**NOBLEWOMAN (Scornful, Smug):**
Start: (00:34.80) | End: (00:36.80)
"Not as a bride this time."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.80) | End: (00:39.80)
Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:43.80)
Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

**CATHERINE (O.S.) (Derisive, Projecting):**
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:44.20)
"Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.80) | End: (00:48.50)
High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.

**CATHERINE (V.O.) (Mocking, Resonant):**
Start: (00:45.00) | End: (00:48.00)
"This is the world you thought you belonged to."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:52.80)
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.

**CATHERINE (Spiteful, Boastful):**
Start: (00:48.60) | End: (00:52.40)
"And now they can all see what you truly are."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:57.80)
Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:57.50)
Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:57.80) | End: (01:00.80)
Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.

**JULIANA (Defiant, Unbowed):**
Start: (00:58.00) | End: (01:00.50)
"You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.00)
Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.

**CATHERINE (O.S.) (Murmured, Cold):**
Start: (01:01.00) | End: (01:03.50)
"Still arrogant. Still standing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.00) | End: (01:08.50)
Full shot of Catherine turning back to Rupert at the altar, dismissing Juliana's defiance as beneath her.

**CATHERINE (Dismissive):**
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:05.40)
"Come."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:08.50) | End: (01:10.50)
Close-up of Catherine's and Rupert's gloved hands clasping together over the velvet altar cushion.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:15.00)
Medium two-shot of Catherine gazing up adoringly into Rupert's eyes, her tone intoxicatingly intimate.

**CATHERINE (Intimate, Ambitious):**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:14.80)
"Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:15.00) | End: (01:17.50)
Close-up of Rupert's face breaking into a calculating, ambitious grin.

Start: (01:15.80) | End: (01:17.00)
"Nothing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:17.50) | End: (01:20.50)
Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.

Start: (01:18.00) | End: (01:19.30)

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:20.50) | End: (01:21.80)
Wide shot centered down the aisle toward the massive closed entrance doors.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:21.00) | End: (01:25.50)
Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:21.80) | End: (01:24.00)
A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.80) | End: (01:24.50)
Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.50) | End: (01:28.50)
Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:28.50) | End: (01:32.00)
Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:29.00) | End: (01:33.50)
Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:32.00) | End: (01:36.09)
Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.

SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:17.80

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:10.50)
Low-angle shot through drifting smoke and rubble across the stone floor, tilting up as polished boots step over splintered wood, revealing an imposing nobleman in a gold-embroidered navy coat.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:01.00) | End: (00:10.50)
Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shocked, Trembling):**
Start: (00:11.20) | End: (00:12.60)
"Who are you?"

**ALEXANDER (Low, Resonant):**
Start: (00:12.80) | End: (00:14.60)
"You already know."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:14.60) | End: (00:16.60)
Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.

**JULIANA (Breathless, Tearful Whisper):**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:16.40)
"Alexander..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.60) | End: (00:17.90)
Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.

**ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring):**
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:17.90)
"Juliana."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.90) | End: (00:21.50)
Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical):**
Start: (00:18.00) | End: (00:21.20)
"Guards! Arrest this imposter!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.50) | End: (00:23.40)
Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

**ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant):**
Start: (00:22.00) | End: (00:23.40)
"We will not."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.40) | End: (00:26.50)
Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged):**
Start: (00:23.50) | End: (00:25.20)
"I said arrest him!"

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged):**
Start: (00:25.50) | End: (00:26.50)
"Why?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:28.80)
Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

**ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent):**
Start: (00:26.70) | End: (00:28.80)
"Because we know who he is."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.80) | End: (00:30.40)
Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.

**CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive):**
Start: (00:29.00) | End: (00:30.30)
"Rupert..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.40) | End: (00:33.80)
Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken):**
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:33.80)
"You cannot be him. Alexander died!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.80) | End: (00:39.90)
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding):**
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:39.80)
"And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:39.90) | End: (00:44.80)
Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears):**
Start: (00:40.20) | End: (00:42.50)
"Alexander..."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:44.80) | End: (00:48.00)
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

**ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent):**
Start: (00:48.00) | End: (00:49.00)
"Mother."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:54.00)
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving):**
Start: (00:49.20) | End: (00:53.80)
"Look at you... my beautiful boy."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (01:03.50)
Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud):**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (01:01.80)
"I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be."

**ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute):**
Start: (01:02.00) | End: (01:04.00)
"I have come home, Mother."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:04.00) | End: (01:12.50)
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

**ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative):**
Start: (01:04.20) | End: (01:12.40)
"Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:12.50) | End: (01:13.80)
Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.80) | End: (01:17.80)
Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

**ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful):**
Start: (01:13.80) | End: (01:17.50)
"And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: When Rupert frantically orders Alexander's arrest, the royal guards refuse and salute the true Duke, before damning Crown intelligence documents expose Rupert and Lord Sterling's treasonous plot.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 42; inside the ruined cathedral, Alexander confronts Rupert before the congregation, armed with evidence from the Crown to reclaim his rightful title.

scenes.heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:54.96

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.80)
Medium close-up on Rupert Ashburn standing before the altar, trembling with mounting panic and rage.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Hysterical, Panicked):**
Start: (00:00.60) | End: (00:02.40)
"You're lying!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:02.40) | End: (00:03.90)
Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:03.80) | End: (00:08.00)
Tracking shot swinging around Rupert as he turns toward the royal guards stationed along the aisle, pointing furiously down the center of the hall.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shrieking, Frantic):**
Start: (00:03.90) | End: (00:07.40)
"This man is an imposter! Arrest him!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.00) | End: (00:10.50)
Wide symmetrical shot framing Alexander Ashburn standing immovable in the center of the cathedral, flanking lines of red-coated guards on both sides.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:08.20) | End: (00:10.50)
Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:13.50)
Extreme close-up on Rupert's furious face, veins bulging at his temples.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Enraged, Screaming):**
Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:13.20)
"I said arrest him!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.20)
Medium shot on the Royal Guard Captain in ceremonial bearskin uniform standing steadfast.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:16.00)
The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

**ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Defiant):**
Start: (00:14.20) | End: (00:15.80)
"We will not."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.20) | End: (00:17.80)
Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Outraged, Stunned):**
Start: (00:16.20) | End: (00:18.00)
"I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.80) | End: (00:19.20)
Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate):**
Start: (00:18.10) | End: (00:19.00)
"Your Duke!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.20) | End: (00:21.80)
Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:19.20) | End: (00:21.60)
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

**ROYAL GUARD (Calm, Resolute):**
Start: (00:19.20) | End: (00:21.50)
"No. He is your Duke."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:24.00)
Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:22.00) | End: (00:24.00)
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:24.00) | End: (00:26.00)
Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Flustered):**
Start: (00:24.10) | End: (00:25.80)
"You have all been deceived!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.00) | End: (00:28.00)
Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Authoritative):**
Start: (00:26.10) | End: (00:28.00)
"Then let the Crown decide."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:28.00) | End: (00:30.00)
Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:28.20) | End: (00:30.00)
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.00) | End: (00:33.80)
Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

**ALEXANDER (Grave, Powerful):**
Start: (00:30.00) | End: (00:33.40)
"These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."

**ALEXANDER (Commanding):**
Start: (00:33.50) | End: (00:34.50)
"Read the first."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.80) | End: (00:35.00)
Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:37.00)
Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:35.20) | End: (00:37.00)
The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:42.80)
Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:37.20) | End: (00:38.60)
Crisp sound of parchment turning.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Clear, Formal):**
Start: (00:37.80) | End: (00:42.50)
"Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:43.90)
Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.90) | End: (00:47.80)
Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Solemn, Objective):**
Start: (00:44.00) | End: (00:47.40)
"Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:50.80)
Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Accusing, Measured):**
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:50.80)
"The report identifies the leak as deliberate."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:50.80) | End: (00:54.80)
Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Voice Continuing):**
Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:54.40)
"Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:51.80) | End: (00:54.80)
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:57.00)
Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Terrified):**
Start: (00:55.00) | End: (00:56.50)
"No..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:57.00) | End: (01:00.00)
Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable):**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:00.00)
"Read the names."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.00) | End: (01:03.00)
Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Deliberate, Damning):**
Start: (01:00.60) | End: (01:02.50)
"Lord Henry Sterling."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:03.00) | End: (01:04.50)
Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing):**
Start: (01:03.10) | End: (01:04.20)
"Rupert Ashburn."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.00)
Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.00) | End: (01:08.80)
Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

**DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Devastated):**
Start: (01:06.50) | End: (01:08.00)
"My God..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:08.80) | End: (01:11.20)
Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

**ALEXANDER (Furious, Thunderous):**
Start: (01:09.00) | End: (01:11.30)
"You sold my men to the enemy."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:12.70)
Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Denying):**
Start: (01:11.40) | End: (01:12.70)
"I didn't!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:12.70) | End: (01:14.80)
Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

**ALEXANDER (Resonant, Accusatory):**
Start: (01:12.80) | End: (01:15.20)
"And when you believed I was dead..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:16.00)
Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.00) | End: (01:17.80)
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.

**ALEXANDER (Venomous):**
Start: (01:16.10) | End: (01:17.60)
"You took my title."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:17.80) | End: (01:21.00)
Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:18.00) | End: (01:19.40)
Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.00) | End: (01:25.00)
Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Grave, Official):**
Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:25.80)
"Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:25.00) | End: (01:28.00)
Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing):**
Start: (01:26.00) | End: (01:28.50)
"Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:28.00) | End: (01:33.20)
Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

**CROWN OFFICIAL (Loud, Authoritative):**
Start: (01:28.60) | End: (01:33.00)
"His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:33.20) | End: (01:36.50)
Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Desperate):**
Start: (01:33.40) | End: (01:36.40)
"I was told he was dead!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:39.80)
Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Penetrating):**
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:39.80)
"You were told exactly what you needed to hear."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.80) | End: (01:42.20)
Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Betraying):**
Start: (01:40.00) | End: (01:42.20)
"Sterling handled the report!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:42.20) | End: (01:43.40)

logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:13.80

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.20)
Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.20)
The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:03.20) | End: (00:08.60)
Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.

**POLICE CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern):**
Start: (00:03.30) | End: (00:08.20)
"Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.60) | End: (00:11.40)
Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.

**LORD STERLING (Snarls, Outraged):**
Start: (00:09.10) | End: (00:11.20)
"You have no authority!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.40) | End: (00:13.80)
Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

**POLICE CONSTABLE (Cold, Definite):**
Start: (00:11.40) | End: (00:13.20)
"I have more than enough."

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:13.80
Scene end: 01:10.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:16.40)
Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:14.00) | End: (00:16.40)
A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Shouting):**
Start: (00:14.00) | End: (00:16.80)
"Get your hands off me! Catherine!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:16.40) | End: (00:19.40)
Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.

**BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Screaming):**
Start: (00:17.40) | End: (00:19.30)
"Do something!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.40) | End: (00:22.00)
Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:24.40)
Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.00) | End: (00:24.40)
Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:24.40) | End: (00:27.80)
Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

**CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful):**
Start: (00:25.20) | End: (00:28.00)
"Alexander... I thought you had died."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:27.80) | End: (00:31.20)
Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

**CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping):**
Start: (00:28.40) | End: (00:31.00)
"Do you know what this did to me?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:31.20) | End: (00:32.40)
Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

**CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading):**
Start: (00:31.20) | End: (00:32.40)
"I mourned you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:34.00)
Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

**CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling):**
Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:34.00)
"I waited for you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:35.80)
Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

**CATHERINE (Heartbroken):**
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:38.80)
"For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:38.80)
Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:41.20)
Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

**CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing):**
Start: (00:38.90) | End: (00:41.20)
"I never stopped loving you."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:42.80)
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:42.80)
Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:46.40)
Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

**CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt):**
Start: (00:44.20) | End: (00:46.40)
"You don't remember?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.40) | End: (00:49.00)
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

**CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding):**
Start: (00:46.60) | End: (00:48.80)
"I was supposed to be your Duchess!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:51.00)
Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable):**
Start: (00:49.20) | End: (00:51.00)
"You were never my Duchess."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:53.00)
Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

**CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading):**
Start: (00:51.10) | End: (00:52.80)
"But I loved you!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:55.60)
Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

**ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting):**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:55.50)
"You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.60) | End: (00:59.00)
Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

**CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained):**
Start: (00:56.20) | End: (00:58.20)
"No!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.00) | End: (01:02.40)
Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

**CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying):**
Start: (00:59.80) | End: (01:02.40)
"I loved you before all this!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.40) | End: (01:03.80)
Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

**ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting):**
Start: (01:02.50) | End: (01:03.40)
"Did you?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:03.80) | End: (01:05.00)
Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:05.00) | End: (01:07.80)
Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.80) | End: (01:09.60)
Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:08.00) | End: (01:09.60)
Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:09.60) | End: (01:10.10)
Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.10) | End: (01:10.50)
Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

**CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous):**
Start: (01:10.10) | End: (01:10.40)
"Her?!"

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: Alexander frees Juliana from her chains and proclaims her the Duchess of Ashburton before the stunned congregation, only for an ecclesiastical authority to burst in and declare their marriage legally invalid.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 44's climax where Alexander walked away from Catherine towards Juliana standing in chains at the church doorway.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. CATHEDRAL NAVE – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. CATHEDRAL NAVE – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:48.90

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.00)
Full tracking shot following behind Alexander as he walks down the rubble-covered stone aisle toward Juliana.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.80)
Alexander strides purposefully down the cathedral aisle, ignoring the watching nobles as Juliana stands shackled in her rustic grey dress near the entrance.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:02.80) | End: (00:05.00)
Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, tears welling in her eyes.

**JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful):**
Start: (00:03.20) | End: (00:04.80)
"Alexander..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.00) | End: (00:08.50)
Medium shot as Alexander stops in front of Juliana and sinks onto one knee before her.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:05.20) | End: (00:07.80)
Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.

**ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring):**
Start: (00:07.40) | End: (00:08.90)
"Look at me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.80) | End: (00:09.90)
Low angle close-up of Juliana looking down into Alexander's eyes with rising disbelief.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:09.90) | End: (00:12.20)
Close-up on Alexander's hands as he unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:10.20) | End: (00:11.80)
Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.20) | End: (00:15.00)
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she stares intently into his eyes.

**JULIANA (Breathless, Overcome):**
Start: (00:12.50) | End: (00:14.30)
"Your eyes..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:21.80)
Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:15.20) | End: (00:18.50)
Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.

**JULIANA (Emotional, Realizing):**
Start: (00:17.10) | End: (00:18.70)
"It's you."

**ALEXANDER (Solemn, Loving):**
Start: (00:19.40) | End: (00:21.50)
"It was always me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:24.50)
Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:21.90) | End: (00:24.20)
Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

**JULIANA (Shocked, Wondering):**
Start: (00:22.90) | End: (00:24.40)
"You're the Duke?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:24.50) | End: (00:27.20)
Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.

**ALEXANDER (Firm, Resonant):**
Start: (00:24.60) | End: (00:27.40)
"Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:27.20) | End: (00:29.80)
Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.

**JULIANA (Incredulous, Moved):**
Start: (00:27.60) | End: (00:29.60)
"All this time?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:35.80)
Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

**ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep):**
Start: (00:30.20) | End: (00:33.00)
"You chose me when you believed I was nobody."

**JULIANA (Sincere, Loving):**
Start: (00:33.20) | End: (00:34.90)
"I chose you because you were kind."

**ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate):**
Start: (00:35.10) | End: (00:36.80)
"You chose me when I had nothing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:38.50)
Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.

**JULIANA (Resolute, Warm):**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:38.70)
"I chose you because you had honor."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:38.50) | End: (00:42.00)
Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.

**ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted):**
Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:41.80)
"And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.00) | End: (00:48.90)
Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:42.20) | End: (00:48.50)
Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.

**JULIANA (Soft, Heartfelt):**
Start: (00:43.80) | End: (00:46.00)
"I loved you before I ever knew who you were."

**ALEXANDER (Soft, Vowing):**
Start: (00:46.10) | End: (00:48.80)
"And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:48.90
Scene end: 01:26.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.90) | End: (00:51.80)
Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:51.50)
Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.

**CATHERINE (Pleading, Desperate):**
Start: (00:49.80) | End: (00:51.50)
"Alexander..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.80) | End: (00:58.20)
Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

**ALEXANDER (Furious, Cold):**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (00:58.00)
"You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:02.50)
Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.

**CATHERINE (Gasping, Lying):**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (00:59.80)
"I didn't know!"

**ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Biting):**
Start: (01:00.00) | End: (01:02.40)
"You knew exactly what you were doing!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.50) | End: (01:07.00)
Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.

**ALEXANDER (Booming, Condemning):**
Start: (01:02.60) | End: (01:06.80)
"You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:11.20)
Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

**CATHERINE (Trembling, Stunned):**
Start: (01:08.80) | End: (01:10.50)
"Wife?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:14.50)
Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:14.50)
Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

**ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Resounding):**
Start: (01:11.50) | End: (01:14.00)
"Before the Crown and before God..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.50) | End: (01:20.50)
Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:14.60) | End: (01:20.00)
Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.

**ALEXANDER (Proclaiming, Powerful):**
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:20.40)
"Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:20.50) | End: (01:23.50)
Close-up on Rupert and Mary standing in the pews, their eyes wide with horrified disbelief.

**RUPERT (Gasping, Shellshocked):**
Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:23.00)
"Juliana?!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:23.50) | End: (01:26.50)
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing proudly together, exchanging a loving gaze amid the awestruck crowd.

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: INT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: INT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 01:26.50
Scene end: 02:01.75

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:30.50)
Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:28.20)
Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:31.00)
A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.

**HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern):**
Start: (01:28.40) | End: (01:30.80)
"No one will bow yet!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:30.80) | End: (01:33.00)
Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:33.00) | End: (01:41.20)
Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:33.20) | End: (01:41.00)
The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

**HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe):**
Start: (01:33.20) | End: (01:41.10)
"This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:45.80)
Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.

**HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Official):**
Start: (01:41.50) | End: (01:45.50)
"These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:45.80) | End: (01:48.80)
Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.

**HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute):**
Start: (01:46.20) | End: (01:48.80)
"Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:53.20)
Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.

**HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning):**
Start: (01:49.00) | End: (01:53.00)
"You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:53.20) | End: (01:57.50)
Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:53.50) | End: (01:57.20)
Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:57.50) | End: (02:01.75)
Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:58.00) | End: (02:01.75)
Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.

scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. ASHBURTON ESTATE CHAPEL – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:23.88

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.50)
Full shot of Alexander and Juliana standing side by side before the altar, their hands tightly clasped beneath the soaring stained-glass windows.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.50)
Alexander holds Juliana's hand resolutely as Juliana gazes toward the church aisle where the intrusion unfolds.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:03.50) | End: (00:05.80)
Medium close-up of an elderly noblewoman seated in the pew, clutching her chest with anxious apprehension.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.80) | End: (00:07.10)
Medium shot of Catherine in her lavish bridal gown, her fists clenched tightly in silent fury.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.10) | End: (00:11.00)
Wide tracking shot down the ruined nave aisle as the High Priest marches forward flanked by armed royal guards with halberds.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:07.80) | End: (00:11.00)
Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.00) | End: (00:13.80)
Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.

**HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative):**
Start: (00:11.50) | End: (00:16.80)
"By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:17.20)
Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:16.80)
Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.20) | End: (00:20.50)
Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.

**HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding):**
Start: (00:17.30) | End: (00:20.40)
"None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:22.80)
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.

**HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory):**
Start: (00:20.60) | End: (00:22.80)
"You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.80) | End: (00:26.80)
Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.

**HIGH PRIEST (Scornful, Harsh):**
Start: (00:22.90) | End: (00:26.50)
"...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:30.50)
Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.

**HIGH PRIEST (Resonant, Dismissive):**
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:31.80)
"Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:34.20)
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:32.50) | End: (00:34.50)
Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:37.00)
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.

**ALEXANDER (Gravely, Firm):**
Start: (00:34.30) | End: (00:36.70)
"She married the man... not the title."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:42.80)
Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

**HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive):**
Start: (00:37.30) | End: (00:42.50)
"The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:47.00)
Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

**HIGH PRIEST (Rigid, Formal):**
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:47.00)
"No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:49.00)
Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.

**HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Sharp):**
Start: (00:47.10) | End: (00:49.00)
"No licensed clergyman presided..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.20)
Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

**HIGH PRIEST (Scathing):**
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.20)
"...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:58.20)
Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

**HIGH PRIEST (Thundering):**
Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:58.00)
"And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:02.80)
Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

**JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant):**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:02.50)
"I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.80) | End: (01:05.80)
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

**JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute):**
Start: (01:02.90) | End: (01:05.50)
"I won't ask it for permission to love."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:05.80) | End: (01:11.00)
Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

**HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous):**
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.50)
"Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.00) | End: (01:16.80)
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

**JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained):**
Start: (01:11.40) | End: (01:14.30)
"Then look at this floor honestly, for once."

**JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate):**
Start: (01:14.40) | End: (01:16.60)
"A church called me unworthy."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:18.00)
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

**JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter):**
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:18.00)
"A church chained me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.00) | End: (01:25.80)
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

**JULIANA (Furious, Resolute):**
Start: (01:18.10) | End: (01:21.00)
"Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"

**JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant):**
Start: (01:21.10) | End: (01:25.50)
"God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:25.80) | End: (01:29.20)
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

**CATHERINE (Malicious, Taunting):**
Start: (01:26.10) | End: (01:29.00)
"Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:29.20) | End: (01:32.50)
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

**HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening):**
Start: (01:29.30) | End: (01:32.40)
"Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:32.50) | End: (01:36.00)
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

**HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe):**
Start: (01:32.20) | End: (01:36.20)
"God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:36.00) | End: (01:36.80)
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:40.50)
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

**HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Threatening):**
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:40.40)
"And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:40.50) | End: (01:41.80)
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:41.80) | End: (01:46.80)
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

**ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute):**
Start: (01:41.80) | End: (01:46.50)
"A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."

**CAMERA:**

logline: While Alexander reassures Juliana of their unbreakable bond amid the council's opposition, a destitute Catherine begs for sanctuary at Ashbourne—only for Juliana to offer her survival under the strict humiliation of a scullery maid.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 46's ecclesiastical challenge by the High Priest. While Catherine plots in secret to remain on the estate, the morning brings her disgrace to light as Juliana decides her fate.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. ESTATE CHAMBERS – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. ESTATE CHAMBERS – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:21.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:01.80)
Low-angle focus on a dripping candle burning on a wooden table beside a dark window looking out into the misty night.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:08.50)
Medium close-up of Catherine in a lace nightgown and lilac robe, holding a goblet of red wine with cold determination.

**CATHERINE (Calculated, Defiant):**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:08.20)
"Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:14.80)
Two-shot framing Catherine in the background with a muscular, bare-chested conspirator standing in shadow beside her.

**CONSPIRATOR (Low, Warning):**
Start: (00:08.80) | End: (00:14.50)
"Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:14.80) | End: (00:18.30)
Close-up profile of Catherine leaning close to the man's shoulder, her eyes burning with ambition.

**CATHERINE (Commanding, Scheming):**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:18.20)
"Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.30) | End: (00:21.50)
Silhouette shot against the tall arched window as Catherine turns her back to him.

**CATHERINE (Ruthless, Focused):**
Start: (00:18.50) | End: (00:21.20)
"Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest."

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. DUKE'S BEDCHAMBER – MORNING
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. DUKE'S BEDCHAMBER – MORNING
Scene start: 00:21.50
Scene end: 00:55.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.50) | End: (00:23.20)
Atmospheric wide pan across the spacious master bedroom, daylight spilling softly through tall Gothic windows onto the hearth fire.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.20) | End: (00:26.50)
Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.

**JULIANA (Anxious, Trembling):**
Start: (00:23.40) | End: (00:26.80)
"What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:30.50)
Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.

**JULIANA (Vulnerable, Fearful):**
Start: (00:27.00) | End: (00:30.30)
"What if they strip your title? Because of me?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:35.00)
Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.

**JULIANA (Despairing):**
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:35.20)
"I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.50) | End: (00:37.50)
Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.

**ALEXANDER (Gentle, Resolute):**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:37.80)
"Look at me, Juliana."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:37.50) | End: (00:42.50)
Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.

**ALEXANDER (Fierce, Loving):**
Start: (00:38.20) | End: (00:42.50)
"You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:42.50) | End: (00:45.80)
Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.

**ALEXANDER (Deep, Unwavering):**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:45.50)
"You are my wife."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:48.00)
Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.

**ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Steadfast):**
Start: (00:45.80) | End: (00:54.80)
"You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."

SCENE 03

scenes.label: SCENE 03
scenes.heading: EXT. ASHBOURNE COURTYARD – DAY
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 03
Scene heading: EXT. ASHBOURNE COURTYARD – DAY
Scene start: 00:55.50
Scene end: 01:23.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:55.50) | End: (00:56.80)
Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (01:00.00)
Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.

**LADY ASHBOURNE (Sharp, Contemptuous):**
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:59.80)
"You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:00.00) | End: (01:03.50)
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.

**CATHERINE (Desperate, Weeping):**
Start: (01:00.50) | End: (01:03.40)
"I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:03.50) | End: (01:07.00)
Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.

**CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading):**
Start: (01:03.50) | End: (01:06.80)
"London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:11.50)
Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.

**LADY ASHBOURNE (Cold, Unforgiving):**
Start: (01:07.20) | End: (01:11.20)
"She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:11.50) | End: (01:14.80)
Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.

**VAUGHN (Gruff, Ready):**
Start: (01:11.80) | End: (01:14.80)
"One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:18.80)
Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.

**ALEXANDER (Furious, Decisive):**
Start: (01:15.20) | End: (01:18.50)
"Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.80) | End: (01:21.80)
Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

**CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming):**
Start: (01:18.80) | End: (01:21.80)
"Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:21.80) | End: (01:23.50)
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

**JULIANA (Clear, Authoritative):**
Start: (01:22.20) | End: (01:23.40)
"Stop."

SCENE 04

scenes.label: SCENE 04
scenes.heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 04
Scene heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 01:23.50
Scene end: 02:14.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:23.50) | End: (01:26.50)
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

**ALEXANDER (Indignant, Protective):**
Start: (01:24.00) | End: (01:26.50)
"Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:28.00)
Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

**JULIANA (Calm, Composed):**
Start: (01:26.70) | End: (01:27.80)
"She did."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:28.00) | End: (01:31.00)
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

**JULIANA (Dignified, Principled):**
Start: (01:28.20) | End: (01:31.00)
"But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:35.00)
Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

**JULIANA (Steely, Direct):**
Start: (01:31.50) | End: (01:35.00)
"If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:35.50) | End: (01:38.80)
Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

**CATHERINE (Incredulous, Stunned):**
Start: (01:36.00) | End: (01:38.80)
"You want me? As a guest?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:38.80) | End: (01:41.20)
Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.

**JULIANA (Unflinching, Firm):**
Start: (01:39.20) | End: (01:41.00)
"As a scullery maid."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:44.80)
Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.

**CATHERINE (Outraged, Venomous):**
Start: (01:41.50) | End: (01:44.50)
"You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:44.80) | End: (01:48.50)
Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.

**JULIANA (Measured, Commanding):**
Start: (01:45.20) | End: (01:48.50)
"You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:48.50) | End: (01:51.50)
Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.

**JULIANA (Stern, Demanding):**
Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:51.50)
"You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:51.50) | End: (01:54.50)
Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.

**JULIANA (Unforgiving):**
Start: (01:51.80) | End: (01:54.50)
"You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:54.50) | End: (01:58.50)
Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.

**JULIANA (Stern, Final):**
Start: (01:54.80) | End: (01:58.50)
"One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:58.50) | End: (02:01.80)
Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.

**CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated):**
Start: (01:59.20) | End: (02:01.60)
"You humiliate me."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:01.80) | End: (02:07.50)
Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.

**JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign):**
Start: (02:02.20) | End: (02:07.20)
"I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:07.50) | End: (02:11.50)
Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.

**CATHERINE (Broken, Defeated):**
Start: (02:08.50) | End: (02:11.20)
"I accept, Your Grace."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:11.50) | End: (02:14.00)
Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---
