timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: LADY ASHBOURNE (Cold, Unforgiving)
timeline_events.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
timeline_events.text: "She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: VAUGHN (Gruff, Ready)
timeline_events.speaker: VAUGHN
timeline_events.text: "One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Decisive)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Clear, Authoritative)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "Stop."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: ALEXANDER (Indignant, Protective)
timeline_events.speaker: ALEXANDER
timeline_events.text: "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Composed)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "She did."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Dignified, Principled)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Steely, Direct)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Stunned)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "You want me? As a guest?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Unflinching, Firm)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "As a scullery maid."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Outraged, Venomous)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Measured, Commanding)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Stern, Demanding)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Unforgiving)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Stern, Final)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "You humiliate me."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign)
timeline_events.speaker: JULIANA
timeline_events.text: "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Broken, Defeated)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "I accept, Your Grace."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-047-Episode 1688396.txt

source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt
logline: While feigning submission after her public humiliation, Catherine schemes in secret, plotting to use the council's ten-day reprieve to strike back at Alexander and Juliana with the aid of Father Thomas.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 47's public disgrace where Catherine bowed to Juliana and accepted the position of a maid; in private, Catherine sheds her feigned defeat and initiates her counter-plot.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:26.70

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.50)
Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.00)
Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.

**CATHERINE (Vindictive, Cold):**
Start: (00:02.40) | End: (00:07.50)
"Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:08.50)
Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:07.80) | End: (00:12.30)
Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.

**CATHERINE (Scheming):**
Start: (00:08.00) | End: (00:12.30)
"Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:12.30) | End: (00:20.00)
Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.

**CATHERINE (Intense, Measured):**
Start: (00:12.60) | End: (00:14.90)
"Ten days for the council to sit."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:18.50)
Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.

**CATHERINE (Calculating):**
Start: (00:15.10) | End: (00:17.20)
"Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."

**CATHERINE (Dark, Threatening):**
Start: (00:17.40) | End: (00:19.70)
"Ten days for a decree to be undone."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:20.00) | End: (00:26.70)
Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.

**CATHERINE (Menacing, Resolute):**
Start: (00:20.10) | End: (00:23.70)
"Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."

**CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm):**
Start: (00:23.90) | End: (00:26.50)
"And doors can be closed from the other side."

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 00:26.70
Scene end: 01:20.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.70) | End: (00:30.80)
Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:29.50)
Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.

**AGNES (Hushed, Submissive):**
Start: (00:29.20) | End: (00:30.80)
"You sent for me, my lady?"

**CATHERINE (Commanding, Sharp):**
Start: (00:30.90) | End: (00:32.00)
"Lock it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:33.90)
Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:32.30) | End: (00:33.80)
Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:36.50)
Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:43.00)
Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

**CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing):**
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:37.10)
"Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."

**CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating):**
Start: (00:37.30) | End: (00:39.00)
"Good. Let them remember it."

**CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory):**
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:43.00)
"Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:46.80)
Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.

**AGNES (Anxious, Whispering):**
Start: (00:43.30) | End: (00:46.80)
"My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:51.50)
Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.

**CATHERINE (Confident, Devious):**
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:51.30)
"I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:58.20)
Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.

**CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming):**
Start: (00:52.00) | End: (00:55.00)
"Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."

**CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding):**
Start: (00:55.20) | End: (00:58.20)
"Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:01.00)
Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.

**AGNES (Apprehensive):**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:00.60)
"If someone sees him come to you..."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:01.00) | End: (01:06.90)
Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.

**CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening):**
Start: (01:01.80) | End: (01:04.00)
"Then no one sees him."

**CATHERINE (Authoritative):**
Start: (01:04.30) | End: (01:06.90)
"That is precisely your job tonight."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:06.90) | End: (01:13.50)
Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:09.00)
Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.

**CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding):**
Start: (01:07.80) | End: (01:10.50)
"Send for the priest. Tonight."

**CATHERINE (Firm, Final):**
Start: (01:10.80) | End: (01:13.40)
"And make sure no one sees him arrive."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:16.80)
Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:20.00)
Exterior shot looking through the dark diamond-paned window frame at Catherine standing motionless in the warm candlelight, staring outward into the night with cold, unyielding ambition as the scene fades to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating)

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory)

timeline_events.text: "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA

timeline_events.label: AGNES (Anxious, Whispering)

timeline_events.text: "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."

timeline_events.label: CAMERA

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Confident, Devious)

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: AGNES (Apprehensive)

timeline_events.text: "If someone sees him come to you..."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Then no one sees him."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-048-Episode 1688397.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Authoritative)

timeline_events.text: "That is precisely your job tonight."

timeline_events.label: CAMERA

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding)

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Firm, Final)

logline: Meeting Father Thomas in an abandoned wing of the manor before dawn, Catherine orchestrates a calculated conspiracy to stall the council hearing and extract inside intelligence, sealing their treasonous alliance with intimate assurance.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Catherine sending Agnes to fetch Father Thomas under cover of darkness; now in Episode 49, Father Thomas slips into the secluded wing for their covert rendezvous.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. FORGOTTEN MANOR WING - NIGHT
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. FORGOTTEN MANOR WING - NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 02:24.75

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:05.20)
Wide tracking shot down a dark, derelict hallway lined with dust-sheet draped furniture and peeling wallpaper. At the far end, a door creaks open, revealing a cloaked figure stepping in.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:01.00) | End: (00:04.50)
Hinges creaking softly followed by the muffled thud of a heavy wooden door clicking shut.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:05.20)
Father Thomas, clad in a hooded dark mantle over priestly black robes, secures the door behind him and steps into the shadows of the abandoned corridor.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:05.20) | End: (00:07.00)
Medium shot on Catherine, draped in a dark hooded cloak over a lavish crimson bodice, holding a brass candlestick aloft.

**CATHERINE (Quietly Chiding):**
Start: (00:05.40) | End: (00:06.80)
"You took your time."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.00) | End: (00:08.80)
Over-the-shoulder shot past Father Thomas's cloaked back looking toward Catherine illuminated in warm candlelight.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.80) | End: (00:15.50)
Medium close-up of Father Thomas under his black hood, his stern face framed by the clerical collar and silver crucifix resting on his chest.

**FATHER THOMAS (Low, Measured):**
Start: (00:09.00) | End: (00:15.20)
"Agnes is thorough. She made me wait for a groom to finish his rounds before she'd let me past the stables."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:19.80)
Close-up profile of Catherine, turning with a slight, knowing smirk.

**CATHERINE (Pleased, Cold):**
Start: (00:15.80) | End: (00:18.80)
"Good. That's what I pay her for."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:19.80) | End: (00:22.00)
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps forward and sets the heavy candleholder onto a small round table draped in grey cloth between them.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:20.00) | End: (00:22.00)
Catherine sets down the brass candleholder, the flame flickering across their faces.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:22.00) | End: (00:27.50)
Tight close-up on Father Thomas's face, the candlelight dancing in his calculating eyes.

**FATHER THOMAS (Grave):**
Start: (00:22.20) | End: (00:27.20)
"No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:33.20)
Close-up on Catherine, her blonde ringlets peeking from beneath her velvet hood as she smiles faintly.

**CATHERINE (Unfazed):**
Start: (00:27.80) | End: (00:33.00)
"You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.20) | End: (00:41.80)
Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.

**FATHER THOMAS (Dry, Cynical):**
Start: (00:33.50) | End: (00:41.50)
"A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:41.80) | End: (00:46.80)
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.

**CATHERINE (Assertive, Warning):**
Start: (00:42.00) | End: (00:46.50)
"It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:48.50)
Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:53.00)
Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.

**CATHERINE (Scheming):**
Start: (00:48.80) | End: (00:52.80)
"Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:59.80)
Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.

**FATHER THOMAS (Reflective, Brooding):**
Start: (00:53.20) | End: (00:59.50)
"Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.80) | End: (01:02.80)
Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.

**CATHERINE (Amused):**
Start: (01:00.00) | End: (01:02.50)
"You always did have a taste for symbolism."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:02.80) | End: (01:07.20)
Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.

**FATHER THOMAS (Intimate, Candid):**
Start: (01:03.00) | End: (01:07.10)
"And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:07.20) | End: (01:12.40)
Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.

**CATHERINE (Strict, Urgent):**
Start: (01:07.40) | End: (01:12.20)
"Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:12.40) | End: (01:17.00)
Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.

**FATHER THOMAS (Direct):**
Start: (01:12.60) | End: (01:16.80)
"What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:17.00) | End: (01:24.00)
Medium close-up of Catherine raising one hand slightly, emphasizing her terms.

**CATHERINE (Calculating, Determined):**
Start: (01:17.20) | End: (01:23.80)
"First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:24.00) | End: (01:31.40)
Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.

**CATHERINE (Fierce, Uncompromising):**
Start: (01:24.20) | End: (01:31.20)
"Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:31.40) | End: (01:34.20)
Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.

**FATHER THOMAS (Skeptical):**
Start: (01:31.60) | End: (01:34.00)
"You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:34.20) | End: (01:38.00)
Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.

**CATHERINE (Haughty, Imperious):**
Start: (01:34.40) | End: (01:37.80)
"I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:38.00) | End: (01:43.80)
Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:38.20) | End: (01:42.50)
Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.

**CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute):**
Start: (01:38.30) | End: (01:43.20)
"Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:43.80) | End: (01:53.00)
Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.

**FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave):**
Start: (01:44.20) | End: (01:52.80)
"If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:53.00) | End: (01:58.00)
Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.

**CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring):**
Start: (01:53.20) | End: (01:57.80)
"Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:58.00) | End: (02:04.80)
Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.

**FATHER THOMAS (Stern, Stark):**
Start: (01:58.20) | End: (02:04.50)
"Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:04.80) | End: (02:08.80)
Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.

**CATHERINE (Tempting):**
Start: (02:05.00) | End: (02:08.50)
"Careful men who help me also get remembered."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:08.80) | End: (02:14.50)
Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.

**CATHERINE (Whispering, Promising):**
Start: (02:09.20) | End: (02:14.20)
"A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:19.80)
Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:15.00) | End: (02:19.50)
Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.

**FATHER THOMAS (Low, Resigned):**
Start: (02:15.20) | End: (02:19.50)
"The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:19.80) | End: (02:22.80)
Close-up on Father Thomas looking down into her eyes.

**FATHER THOMAS (Softly):**
Start: (02:20.00) | End: (02:22.50)
"Then we understand each other."

**ACTION:**
Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:22.80)
Catherine reaches out and places her slender hand firmly into Father Thomas's open palm.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:22.80) | End: (02:24.00)
Close-up of Catherine gazing up at him, her eyes glistening in the candlelight.

**CATHERINE (Intimate):**
Start: (02:23.00) | End: (02:24.00)
"We always have."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (02:24.00) | End: (02:24.75)
Extreme close-up as Father Thomas gently raises his other hand and cups Catherine's cheek tenderly, her hand resting against his chest as she leans into his touch before cutting to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Unfazed)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Dry, Cynical)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Assertive, Warning)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Reflective, Brooding)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Amused)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "You always did have a taste for symbolism."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Intimate, Candid)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Strict, Urgent)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Direct)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine raising one hand slightly, emphasizing her terms.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Calculating, Determined)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Fierce, Uncompromising)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Skeptical)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Haughty, Imperious)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Stern, Stark)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Tempting)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "Careful men who help me also get remembered."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Promising)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Low, Resigned)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up on Father Thomas looking down into her eyes.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Softly)
timeline_events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
timeline_events.text: "Then we understand each other."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: ACTION
timeline_events.text: Catherine reaches out and places her slender hand firmly into Father Thomas's open palm.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Close-up of Catherine gazing up at him, her eyes glistening in the candlelight.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CATHERINE (Intimate)
timeline_events.speaker: CATHERINE
timeline_events.text: "We always have."
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

timeline_events.label: CAMERA
timeline_events.text: Extreme close-up as Father Thomas gently raises his other hand and cups Catherine's cheek tenderly, her hand resting against his chest as she leans into his touch before cutting to black.
timeline_events.source_filename: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2).zip/I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke/episode-049-Episode 1688398.txt

logline: Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 49, where Father Thomas and Catherine sealed their covert alliance in the secluded wing; now, their secret affair deepens into political extortion before being shattered by an unexpected witness.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. ABANDONED BEDCHAMBER – PRE-DAWN
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. ABANDONED BEDCHAMBER – PRE-DAWN
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:10.50

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:01.80)
High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.00)
Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:07.00)
Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.

**CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive):**
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:05.80)
"A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:05.80) | End: (00:07.20)
Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:07.00) | End: (00:11.80)
Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.

**FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical):**
Start: (00:07.20) | End: (00:11.20)
"A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.80) | End: (00:15.80)
Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.

**CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering):**
Start: (00:12.00) | End: (00:15.50)
"Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:15.80) | End: (00:18.80)
Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.

**CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional):**
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:18.50)
"Name your price."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:26.50)
Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

**FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding):**
Start: (00:19.40) | End: (00:25.00)
"The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:30.50)
Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.

**CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous):**
Start: (00:27.20) | End: (00:30.20)
"That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:35.80)
Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.

**FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold):**
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:35.00)
"Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:39.80)
Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.

**CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating):**
Start: (00:36.50) | End: (00:39.40)
"Unsupervised. In your hands alone."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:43.00)
Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.

**FATHER THOMAS (Grave):**
Start: (00:40.40) | End: (00:42.50)
"For as long as it holds."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:48.50)
Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.

**CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing):**
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:48.00)
"Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:54.50)
Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.

**FATHER THOMAS (Chuckle, Resigned):**
Start: (00:49.80) | End: (00:54.00)
"I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:54.50) | End: (00:59.80)
Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.

**CATHERINE (Murmuring):**
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:56.50)
"In another room no one uses?"

**FATHER THOMAS (Whispering):**
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:59.20)
"Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.80) | End: (01:05.50)
Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.

**CATHERINE (Low, Carnal):**
Start: (01:00.30) | End: (01:04.80)
"Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:05.50) | End: (01:10.50)
Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:05.80) | End: (01:10.50)
Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.

SCENE 02

scenes.label: SCENE 02
scenes.heading: INT. MANOR CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
scenes.source_text:
SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. MANOR CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
Scene start: 01:10.50
Scene end: 01:20.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.50)
Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:10.80) | End: (01:13.50)
Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:16.50)
Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:14.00) | End: (01:16.50)
Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.50) | End: (01:18.50)
Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:18.50)
Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:17.20) | End: (01:18.60)
Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:18.50) | End: (01:20.00)
Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---
